title: SEO Strategy & Product Manager
description:
SEO Strategy & Product Manager

Role Overview



The SEO Strategy & Product Manager is responsible for supporting the SEO Lead by ensuring the agency's SEO strategies, frameworks, deliverables, and service offerings remain aligned with current search trends, algorithm updates, AI-driven search experiences, and industry best practices.



This role focuses on identifying the activities most likely to generate results, evaluating emerging opportunities, and ensuring SEO products, methodologies, and strategic frameworks continue to evolve alongside changes in Google Search, AI search, and the wider search landscape.



The successful candidate will act as the agency's SEO research, strategy, and product specialist, helping shape the future direction of SEO services while supporting the SEO Lead with strategic recommendations, innovation, and continuous improvement.



This is not a people management role. It is a strategic role focused on research, product development, quality assurance, and ensuring the agency remains ahead of industry changes.



Key Responsibilities

SEO Strategy Development

Support the SEO Lead in developing and refining SEO strategies.

Develop frameworks for Local SEO, National SEO, E-commerce SEO, Technical SEO, GEO, AEO, Entity SEO, and Authority Building.

Review current methodologies and identify opportunities for improvement.

Ensure strategic recommendations remain aligned with current search engine requirements and industry best practices.

Assist with campaign planning and strategic direction where required.

Develop scalable SEO systems and frameworks that can be applied across multiple clients and industries.

SEO Product & Package Ownership

Review and improve SEO packages on an ongoing basis.

Ensure deliverables remain relevant, effective, and focused on measurable outcomes.

Identify opportunities to improve service offerings and client results.

Recommend additions, removals, or adjustments to package inclusions.

Develop new products and service offerings in response to industry changes.

Ensure agency offerings remain competitive and future-focused.

Search, AI & Industry Research

Monitor Google algorithm updates and search industry developments.

Stay informed on developments across:

Google Search

AI Overviews

ChatGPT Search

Gemini

Perplexity

Claude

GEO (Generative Engine Optimisation)

AEO (Answer Engine Optimisation)

Entity SEO

Technical SEO

Research competitor offerings and emerging opportunities.

Translate industry developments into actionable recommendations.

Performance & Activity Evaluation

Assess whether current SEO activities are generating meaningful results.

Identify activities that should be expanded, improved, reduced, or removed.

Review performance trends and emerging opportunities.

Work closely with the SEO Lead to ensure recommendations are supported by data and performance insights.

Ensure SEO activities remain aligned with what is currently working within search.

Authority Building & Link Acquisition Strategy

Develop and maintain authority-building frameworks.

Review and improve link acquisition methodologies.

Research emerging authority signals and trust factors.

Identify opportunities for digital PR and authority growth.

Ensure link-building activities align with current search requirements and best practices.

SOP, Framework & Process Development

Develop and maintain SEO SOPs, templates, checklists, and strategic frameworks.

Ensure internal documentation reflects current best practices.

Create implementation guides for new initiatives and methodologies.

Support consistency, quality assurance, and scalability across SEO delivery.

Internal Education & Knowledge Sharing

Share industry developments and strategic recommendations with internal stakeholders.

Assist in educating the team on new search developments and opportunities.

Document key findings, frameworks, and recommendations.

Help ensure strategic knowledge is accessible and scalable across the business.

Key Deliverables

Monthly

SEO Trends & Industry Insights Report

Algorithm Update Summary

AI Search & GEO Update Report

Package & Deliverable Review

Strategic Recommendations Report

Authority Building & Link Acquisition Review

Quarterly

SEO Product & Package Audit

Strategic Framework Review

Competitor Analysis

SOP & Process Review

New Service & Opportunity Recommendations

SEO Innovation & Roadmap Report

Success Measures

SEO packages remain aligned with current search trends and best practices.

Strategic frameworks are regularly reviewed and improved.

New opportunities are proactively identified and implemented.

Recommendations contribute to improved client outcomes.

SEO offerings remain competitive and commercially viable.

The agency remains ahead of major industry shifts rather than reacting to them.

SEO activities remain focused on what drives measurable results.

Skills & Experience

Essential

Strong SEO strategy experience.

Deep understanding of Google Search and ranking factors.

Strong knowledge of Technical SEO, Content Strategy, Entity SEO, and Link Building.

Understanding of GEO, AEO, AI Search, and emerging search technologies.

Strong analytical and research skills.

Excellent communication and documentation abilities.

Ability to identify trends and convert them into actionable strategies.

Commercial awareness and product-thinking mindset.

Desirable

Experience developing SEO products or service offerings.

Experience reviewing agency SEO frameworks and deliverables.

Familiarity with AI search optimisation and entity-based search strategies.

Experience working within an agency environment.

Application Process



As part of the recruitment process, shortlisted candidates will be required to complete a practical assessment and submit a Loom presentation.



SEO Strategy & Product Review Assessment



Candidates will prepare a 10-15 minute Loom presentation covering:



Future of Search

Key SEO developments expected over the next 12-24 months.

The impact of AI Search, GEO, AEO, Entity SEO, Technical SEO, and Authority Building.

SEO Product & Package Recommendations

Activities agencies should be prioritising.

Activities becoming less valuable.

What a modern SEO package should include.

New services or opportunities worth introducing.

Strategy & Innovation

How SEO offerings should evolve over time.

How algorithm changes and AI search developments should influence strategy.

How to evaluate whether SEO activities remain effective.

Authority Building

Recommended approach to authority building, link acquisition, entity development, digital PR, and trust signals.

90-Day Action Plan

What you would review first.

What improvements you would prioritise.

What recommendations you would make during your first 90 days.

Assessment Criteria



Candidates will be assessed on:



SEO strategy knowledge

Understanding of AI search and emerging trends

Strategic thinking

Commercial awareness

Product development capability

Problem-solving skills

Communication and presentation skills

Ability to translate research into practical recommendations

Mission of the Role



To ensure SEO strategies, deliverables, frameworks, and service offerings continuously evolve with search engine algorithms, AI search platforms, and industry best practices, helping the agency deliver the activities most likely to generate sustainable rankings, traffic, authority, and business growth for clients.

title: Real Estate ISA
description:
We're hiring a full-time Inside Sales Agent (ISA) to run point on lead outreach for Savor Properties — a real estate agent in Northern Virginia.



Your job is simple: call every lead the moment they come in, follow up on a consistent cadence, and book appointments between qualified sellers and our owner, Jay.



You are not closing deals. You are opening conversations.



The best ISAs don't pitch — they listen. They ask good questions. They make the homeowner feel understood before anything else happens. Your edge is empathy and urgency, not a script you're rushing through.





What You'll Be Doing

Inbound Lead Response



Every lead that comes in gets a call. Not in 5 minutes. Not "when you get a chance." Within 10 seconds of receipt — every time. Speed to lead is the standard. This is non-negotiable.



Follow-Up Cadence



Leads that don't pick up get worked. You'll follow a structured follow-up sequence — calls, texts, voi
s — until you get a conversation or the lead is officially dead. Nothing falls through the cracks.



Cold Calling



When you're not following up with existing leads, you're dialing cold lists. Lists are provided — your job is to work through them consistently, keep your energy up, and find the people who need what we offer.



Appointment Setting



The goal of every conversation is to understand the homeowner's situation and — if they're a fit — book them for an appointment with Jay. You qualify. Jay closes.



CRM Management



Every call, every outcome, every follow-up is logged in Follow Up Boss. You keep your pipeline clean and your notes sharp. No mystery leads, no ghost activity.



Daily Sales Check-In



Every day, we review your calls and your numbers together. This isn't a performance review — it's a feedback loop. We'll listen to calls, talk through what's working, and sharpen what isn't. The best ISAs get better every single week because they're coachable and they pay attention to the data.





How to Be a Hero

Meeting the standard gets you in the door. This is how you become someone we'd never let go.



You push past the first "no." Not with pressure — with genuine curiosity. You ask one more question, you dig one level deeper, and you find out if there's actually something there. Average ISAs hang up. Great ones turn a "not interested" into a 10-minute conversation.

You bring insights to the check-in. You're not just showing up with numbers. You're showing up with observations. "I noticed leads from this list are going cold faster — here's what I think is happening." You're thinking about the pipeline, not just dialing through it.

You find patterns before we do. Best time to call, which scripts are landing, which objections keep coming up — you're tracking it without being asked. You turn your call activity into intelligence we can actually use.

You make Jay look good in every handoff. When you book an appointment, Jay walks in with context. You've qualified the lead, you've logged the situation, and Jay isn't starting from zero. The handoff is seamless because you made it that way.

You get better every week. You listen back to your own calls. You apply feedback. You don't make the same mistake twice. The ISAs who thrive here are the ones who are always improving — not the ones who think they've already figured it out.





How to Drive Me Crazy

Going quiet after a call. Log it. Every time.

Letting leads sit. Speed to lead isn't a suggestion — it's the standard.

Winging follow-up. There's a cadence. Follow it.

Burning out and going silent. This is a high-volume role. If you're struggling, say something — don't just disappear.

Needing to be reminded. You own your pipeline. I shouldn't have to check your activity to find out what's happening.





Qualifications

Proven experience in phone sales, ISA work, or high-volume outreach — real estate experience is a plus, not a requirement.

Excellent spoken English — warm, clear, and professional.

Comfortable making a high volume of calls daily without losing energy or quality.

Experience with a CRM (Follow Up Boss preferred, but any CRM works).

Reliable internet connection and a quiet, professional calling environment.

Full-time availability during US business hours (Eastern Time preferred).

Self-directed — you manage your own activity without constant check-ins.





Tools You'll Use

Follow Up Boss — CRM for lead tracking and follow-up management

GoHighLevel — CRM for lead tracking and follow-up management

Slack — async communication and daily check-ins

Dialer — provided or recommended based on setup





To Apply

title: Construction Operations Manager — Systems Builder
description:
We are a small Canadian real-estate developer in Nova Scotia. We design and build multi-unit residential projects. Our design side runs on systems that work. Our construction side doesn't yet — and we're going to be honest with you about that.



The mess, plainly: multiple active builds. Subcontractor sourcing that stalls for weeks because we lack options. Procurement scattered across spreadsheets. Supplier outreach so uncoordinated that suppliers have asked who actually speaks for us. Site records living in chat threads and people's memory.



This job is not to follow our process. There isn't one. The job is to build it, then run it with the team.



What you'll own (outcomes, not tasks):



A subcontractor & supplier pipeline — sourcing ? bids ? decision ? contract, visible at every stage

Procurement that doesn't stall: one owner (you), clear status, automated follow-ups

Site execution rhythm: daily logs, punch lists, schedules people can actually trust

The tooling is your call — ClickUp, Sheets, Airtable, Quickbase, GoHighLevel, n8n, anything. We don't require coding. We require systems that keep running when you're not pushing them.



How we work: Remote, full-time, Atlantic Time overlap. You report directly to the CEO, with real authority from day one. We are AI-native — Claude sits inside every workflow here and we'll expect it in yours. We pay for proof, fast: salary reviews follow demonstrated ownership, not anniversaries — ask us to show you how that has worked here. People who build core systems at Helio participate in the upside.



Who tends to fit: estimators, site engineers, QS, construction PMs, and ops leads who got so frustrated with manual chaos that they built trackers, databases, SOPs, or automations nobody asked for. If you have never voluntarily systematized something, this role will frustrate you.



To apply — no cover letter. Answer two questions (bullet points fine; specifics win; please don't polish it with AI):



Show us something you built that nobody asked you to build — a tracker, database, process, automation, or small business. A link beats a description. What broke first, and what did you change?



If you took over construction operations for a company you'd never seen, what would you need to learn in week one — and how would you learn it?



Put FOUNDATION as the first word of your application.

title: Shopify Store Operator — AI-Driven Store (Systems-Minded, Full-Time)
description:
About us

We're a USA-based premium contemporary home décor brand — sculptural furniture, lighting, mirrors, and wall art. Our product pages read like a design gallery, not a discount store. We're looking for one sharp, detail-obsessed person to help us run and grow the store. You'll work US-friendly hours; we'll confirm the exact window.



What you'll do

• Operate our AI-driven store (the core). We run a custom dashboard, an AI agent system, and automation that does a lot of the work. Your job is to understand how it all fits together and run the machine — the right tool, the right step, in the right order.

• Run the AI listing pipeline. Our AI generates the product listings; you operate the workflow, push products live, and keep them flowing as new products arrive. You operate it — you don't write the copy.

• Quality-check for accuracy. Catch the factual errors that matter — wrong dimensions, wrong price, wrong product — before anything goes live.

• Own the store day to day. Handle whatever the Shopify store and storefront need; you're the go-to operator for "the store."

• Troubleshoot. When something looks off (wrong stock on the site, a product not showing, automation acting up), figure out where the problem is and drive the fix or flag it clearly.



This is NOT a copywriting job (the AI writes), NOT customer support, and NOT a basic listings job. It's a run-the-system role for someone who likes understanding how things work.



Who you are

• You're systems-minded and tech-comfortable. You enjoy learning how a complex setup works and can reason about how the pieces connect. You don't need to code — you need to "get" how things run and operate inside them. This is the most important thing.

• You use AI tools (ChatGPT / Claude) daily, know how to drive them to a good result, and can tell when the output is wrong.

• You're comfortable in Shopify (products, variants, collections, the draft-to-active flow).

• You're a troubleshooter — when something breaks, you trace it instead of guessing.

• You're adaptable — happy owning "the whole store," not just ticking off a fixed task list.

• You're meticulous about accuracy. A wrong dimension or price drives you crazy.

• Your written English is strong enough to communicate clearly. (You won't be writing product copy — the AI does that — so polished marketing writing is not required.)



What we offer

• Competitive pay with real raises as you grow.

• Full-time, long-term, stable work with one company (not juggling clients).

• 13th-month pay / year-end bonus plus performance bonuses.

• A founder who values good work and gives clear direction.



HOW TO APPLY (please read — applications that skip a step won't be reviewed)

1. Start your message with the word ATELIER so we know you actually read this post.

2. Tell us: in 2–3 sentences, describe a system, tool, or automated workflow you learned and operated — and how you used an AI tool (ChatGPT, Claude, etc.) in your work.

3. Quick reasoning question. Imagine a store set up like this: a dashboard pushes inventory to Shopify; an AI tool drafts the product listings; nothing goes live until a person approves it. A customer reports that a product shows the wrong stock number on the website. In a few sentences: how would you figure out where the problem is? (We're not looking for a "correct" answer — we want to see how you think through a system.)



We read every application that follows these three steps. We're excited to meet you.

The dream hire here is pretty simple: I wake up, and you've already gone through my inbox, lined up my day, and put a short list in front of me of what matters most. I stop being the guy managing every little thing, and you become the person who keeps it all moving.



Here's the kind of stuff you'd be handling:



- My inbox. Reading it, sorting it, knocking out the easy replies, and only pulling me in when something needs me specifically.

- My calendar. Booking calls, sending reminders, making sure I'm never double-booked or blanking on something.

- A quick daily rundown of what's on, what's urgent, and what I've been avoiding.

- Chasing follow-ups and keeping my clients, vendors, and contractors in the loop.

- Research and prep, so when I have to make a decision the info's already sitting there.

- Keeping a handle on my to-dos so nothing falls through the cracks.

What I care about: your written English needs to be strong, because you'll be
ing and messaging people as me. I want someone who runs ahead of me instead of waiting to be told every step. Ideally you've done the EA or VA thing for a couple years, and bonus points if it was for a founder juggling a lot like me. You should know your way around Google Workspace and Slack and be quick to pick up new tools (we use GoHighLevel and a few others). And since you'd basically have your hands in everything, I need someone reliable and discreet, no exceptions.



It's full-time and I want someone long-term, not a quick gig. I'll need a few hours of your day to line up with my mornings on US East Coast time (so your evening), and the rest can be whenever works for you. If this goes well it becomes a lot more. As you learn how I operate, I want it to grow into a chief-of-staff kind of role with more responsibility and better pay.

Full-Time AI Content Creator (Image + Video) 



About the Role

We are hiring a full-time AI Content Creator to produce high-quality AI image and video content with strong character consistency. This is a pure content-creation role — no posting, no community management, and no DM handling. You create the assets; another team publishes them. Experience producing content for AI influencer / subscription-platform personas.

Student Success & Community Manager

About Us

We are looking for a highly organized, professional, and reliable Student Success & Community Manager to take ownership of student communication inside our Skool (SKOOL) community and help ensure every student receives timely support and attention.



Position Overview



Your primary responsibility will be managing communication inside our Skool community.



On a typical day, you can expect to communicate with approximately 20+ students regarding questions, requests, updates, and support needs.



You will not be responsible for running advertising campaigns, managing ad accounts, or making marketing decisions.



Instead, your role is to:



Communicate with students

Answer common questions

Gather information

Submit student requests

Escalate issues when necessary

Keep conversations organized

Ensure every student feels supported



Think of yourself as the bridge between our students and our internal team.



Primary Responsibilities

Student Communication



You will communicate with students daily inside our Skool community.



Students may reach out regarding:



Advertising questions

Campaign updates

Meta ad account issues

Cost Per Lead (CPL) concerns

Ad creative requests

New ad launch requests

Call requests with management

Tier upgrades

Hiring ad requests

Program questions

Technical issues

General support requests



The most important responsibility in this role is ensuring students receive fast, professional, and helpful responses.



Students should never feel ignored or forgotten.



Response Time Expectations



Students must be checked on and responded to consistently throughout the day.



Minimum expectations include:



Monitoring Skool multiple times daily

Responding to student messages promptly

Following up on conversations when needed

Ensuring students receive updates on outstanding requests

Maintaining a professional and positive experience



Students should generally receive attention 2–3 times per day when active conversations are taking place.



Student Request Management



A major part of this role involves determining when a student request should be submitted.



Student Requests are internal forms used to notify management when a student needs assistance with something that requires backend access or action.



Examples of Student Requests



Submit a Student Request when:



A student wants new ads launched

A student wants ad creative changes

A student wants campaign adjustments

A student wants to lower their CPL

A student reports advertising issues

A student requests technical assistance

A student wants paint correction ads launched

A student wants ceramic coating ads launched

A student requests a call with management

A student needs backend account changes



Every conversation that requires action from management should have a Student Request submitted.



Accuracy and organization are extremely important.



Common Situations You'll Handle

Example #1: Ad Error



Student:

"My ads show an error."



Your responsibility:



Reassure the student

Let them know we will investigate

Gather any necessary information

Submit a Student Request

Example #2: Meta Sca
ssages



Student:

"I received a message saying
 is shutting down my account."



Your responsibility:



Explain that these messages are common scams

Reassure the student

Let them know they can ignore the message



No Student Request required.



Example #3: High Cost Per Lead (CPL)



Student:

"My CPL is too high."



Your responsibility:



Acknowledge the concern

Let them know management will review it

Submit a Student Request



You are not responsible for optimizing campaigns.



Tier Verification Responsibilities



Certain services require students to be enrolled in our Tier 2 program.



Examples include:



Paint Correction Advertising

Ceramic Coating Advertising



If a student requests these services:



If Student Is Tier 2

Submit Student Request

If Student Is Not Tier 2

Direct them to contact the appropriate tea
mber about upgrading

Once upgraded, submit Student Request

Hiring Ad Requests



Students occasionally request hiring advertisements.



When this occurs:



Explain that hiring ads require an additional fee

Direct the student to the appropriate tea
mber to process payment

Once approved, follow internal procedures

Training & Support



You will receive complete training covering:



Student communication

Community management

Student Request procedures

Escalation processes

Company policies

Common student questions

Tier structures

Internal systems



You will also have direct access to management whenever you are unsure how to handle a situation.



We prefer questions over assumptions.



Qualifications

Required

Excellent written English

Strong communication skills

Reliable internet connection

Professional attitude

Strong organizational skills

Detail-oriented

Ability to follow systems and processes

Ability to multitask and manage conversations

Preferred (Not Required)

Customer support experience

Virtual assistant experience

Community management experience

 (Meta) Ads familiarity

Marketing agency experience

GoHighLevel experience

CRM software experience

Social media marketing knowledge



You do not need to know how to run advertisements.



A basic understanding of marketing terminology is helpful, but we will provide training on our systems and processes.



Who Will Succeed In This Role?



The ideal candidate is:



Friendly

Professional

Organized

Responsive

Consistent

Proactive

Comfortable communicating with people throughout the day

Able to follow instructions carefully

Willing to learn and improve



If you enjoy helping people, staying organized, and being part of a growing company where your work directly impacts customer satisfaction, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Part-Time IT & Security Engineer (Tier 2/3)
description:
Part-Time IT & Security Engineer (Tier 2/3)

Weekend Coverage + Optional Weekday Evenings | Remote, Philippines



Sentry is a US-based managed service provider (MSP) and physical security integrator serving small and mid-sized businesses across the New York metro area. On the IT side, we manage our clients' networks, servers, Microsoft 365 environments, endpoints, and phone systems. On the security side, we design, install, and support their video surveillance and access control systems.



We do things differently from most MSPs: we don't run a Tier 1 help desk. When a client reaches us, they get a skilled engineer who takes ownership immediately, not a scripted first-tier queue or an automated phone tree. That first-contact competence is a big part of why our clients enjoy working with us, and it's why we only hire technicians at Tier 2 and above.



We're hiring part-time to cover our weekends, Saturday and Sunday, and we have additional weekday evening shifts available for the right person. Weekends and evenings are much quieter than our weekday daytime operation, so this isn't a high-pressure call queue. You'll handle the calls,
s, and tickets that do come in, owning each from first contact through resolution, and spend the rest of your time moving project work forward: deployments, configurations, maintenance windows, documentation, and backlog cleanup. Weekends and evenings are also when we can safely take systems offline for upgrades that would disrupt clients during the day, so a meaningful part of this role is planned project execution, not just reactive support.



The weekend coverage is what we're most eager to fill. If you're interested, you can also pick up one or more weekday evening shifts on top of it; the full schedule is below.



Because you'll often be our main presence outside core business hours, independence and sound judgment matter here. You won't be alone: you'll have escalation paths to senior engineers and the owner, and we take on the hardest problems as a team, but you should be comfortable owning a client environment and knowing when to escalate. The role is fully remote, and you'll be a full member of our team, not an isolated, outsourced contractor.



What You'll Do



- Handle client requests by phone,
, and ticket during your shifts, and own them from first contact through resolution

- Deliver a confident, professional experience on every interaction; clients should feel they're in good hands from the first minute

- Execute project work handed off from the weekday team: deployments, migrations, network and system configuration, and backlog items that need uninterrupted time to complete

- Run maintenance windows: patching, firmware upgrades, server maintenance, and other changes best done while clients are offline

- Administer Microsoft 365 / Entra ID (Azure AD): user and license provisioning, Exchange Online, mail flow, and
 security

- Monitor and respond to RMM alerts (Atera) and manage endpoint security tools (Huntress, Bitdefender)

- Troubleshoot networks: firewalls (FortiGate), switches and access points (UniFi), VLANs, VPNs, and DNS

- Administer Windows Server, Active Directory, and Group Policy

- Manage and verify backups (Datto)

- Support VoIP systems and IP phones

- Configure, support, and troubleshoot video surveillance systems (IP cameras, NVRs, and video management software such as Hikvision, Digital Watchdog, and Speco), including secure remote access and viewing

- Administer access control systems (users, credentials, and door schedules) and troubleshoot controllers and readers

- Remotely support our field technicians during security-system installs and service calls

- Keep clear, accurate documentation for every client environment, including writing up the project work you complete

- Work alongside our AI tooling, which we use heavily across daily operations



What We're Looking For



- 3+ years of hands-on IT support experience, ideally at an MSP

- Excellent spoken and written English, with a strong customer-first attitude; you'll be the voice of our company on every call

- The confidence to own client interactions and project work independently, along with the judgment to know when to involve the team

- Self-direction: with lighter supervision outside business hours, you should be able to pick up a project, see it through, and document it without hand-holding

- Solid knowledge of Microsoft 365/Entra, Windows Server, Active Directory, and networking fundamentals

- Hands-on experience with firewalls and managed switches (FortiGate and UniFi a strong plus)

- Experience with IP video surveillance and/or access control systems, or the aptitude and willingness to develop this expertise quickly (it's a core part of what we do)

- Reliable high-speed internet with a backup connection

- A quiet, dedicated home workspace



Bonus Points



- Deep familiarity with AI tools, especially Claude, which we use extensively day to day

- Spanish-speaking ability (written and/or spoken)

- Hands-on experience with VMS platforms (e.g., DW Spectrum), access control systems, or remote video monitoring services (e.g., Immix)

- Certifications (CompTIA A+/Network+/Security+, Microsoft, Fortinet NSE, Ubiquiti, Cisco CCNA)

- PowerShell or other scripting



Work Setup



- 100% remote, based in the Philippines

- Part-time, permanent employee position, not contract work

- All hours are in US Eastern Time, which maps to an overnight or early-morning shift in the Philippines (about an hour later when the US is on standard time)



Weekend coverage, the core of this role (both days):

- Saturday, 10:00 AM to 10:00 PM ET (roughly 10:00 PM Sat to 10:00 AM Sun PHT)

- Sunday, 10:00 AM to 10:00 PM ET (roughly 10:00 PM Sun to 10:00 AM Mon PHT)

- About 24 hours per week



Optional weekday evening shifts, pick any one, two, or all three:

- Tuesday, 5:00 PM to 10:00 PM ET (roughly 5:00 AM to 10:00 AM Wed PHT)

- Thursday, 5:00 PM to 10:00 PM ET (roughly 5:00 AM to 10:00 AM Fri PHT)

- Friday, 5:00 PM to 10:00 PM ET (roughly 5:00 AM to 10:00 AM Sat PHT)

- 5 hours per shift

title: Growth Marketer — Acquisition (B2B / Manufacturing) - Content + Strategy Driven B2B Growth
description:
Read this first:



This post is for one specific person: a content-first growth marketer with genuine marketing intelligence, real B2B experience, and a serious work ethic. We are hiring one person. If that sounds like you, keep reading. 



Who we are:



Feight AI builds custom AI solutions for manufacturing companies in Central Europe doing over €1M in annual revenue. We design and build automation specifically for how each client actually runs their operations.



Our vision is simple. We want to be one of the top names companies in our region think of when they need serious AI work done for their business.



Where we are right now: the technical side is solid, the founder closes deals one to one, and the product works. What's missing is marketing. It's at zero. No content, no funnel, no paid presence.



That's the job. A blank canvas. The person we hire gets to define what good marketing at Feight AI looks like from scratch.



We're looking for the person who runs our entire acquisition function on the ground. What we need now is someone to take over content, channels and paid ads. Not as an assistant. As the person who owns this side of the business day to day.



What matters most:



Two things will d
 whether this works.



The first is content creation. Our organic growth on Meta, LinkedIn, YouTube and the blog depends on it, and our paid ads only work if the creative is strong. So we need a real creator. Someone who writes, edits, scripts, and ships content consistently and well.



The second is marketing intelligence. By that we mean the ability to look at the data and figure out what's actually going on. If a campaign is dying, you should be able to tell whether it's an audience problem, a message problem, an offer problem, or a channel problem, and what to try next. We give you the direction. You make it real on the ground and adjust as you go.



If both of these aren't your strong suit, this won't work.



What you'll be doing



Day to day you'll handle:



Posting and managing content across Meta (FB + IG), LinkedIn, YouTube and our blog.

Building funnels: landing pages, lead magnets,
 sequences.

Running paid ads (Meta/LinekdIn/Google): creative, audiences, budgets, testing, scaling.

Using AI tools to move faster than people who do this work manually.



You don't have to be a world expert at every one of these. Competent and resourceful is fine.



What we are not asking for:



No cold outreach. No warm outreach. We are not interested in that channel at the 
nt. The focus is content, funnels and ads.



Who we are hiring:



We are looking for someone who:



Creates content as their main skill. Not someone who "also writes" or manages other writers. You make the stuff yourself.

Can look at a week of data and tell us in five minutes what's working, what isn't, and what they'd change.

Is organized. You know your numbers, you report on a regular rhythm without being chased, and you come to us with proposals, not just observations.

Has actually driven B2B pipeline for international clients before. Real numbers, real results. Not just "campaigns you were part of."

Has B2B acquisition experience specifically. Not general agency work, not e-commerce, not social media management.

Has a strong work ethic. If you say you'll ship something, it ships. On time. At the quality you promised.

Actually likes this work. Hooks, funnels, ads, content. This is the kind of work you like to do.

Wants to earn more through results, not through hours. The base is steady. The bonus is where it gets interesting.

Communicates well, professionally, without us having to chase replies.

Doesn't need micromanaging. We give direction and context. You give back a working engine.

Can start moving fast. You don't need three months to figure out the basics.



This probably isn't for you if:



Content creation isn't your strongest skill.

You can execute a plan but you can't tell why something isn't working when the numbers go sideways.

You've never personally owned B2B acquisition outcomes.

You need long onboarding to figure out the basics.

Your background is general agency, e-commerce or social media management.

You're mainly motivated by hourly pay, not by performance.



What we offer



$1,500/month base, paid reliably and on time.

A performance bonus tied to qualified leads and closed revenue. If your work drives sales, the bonus has no upper limit. This role exists for someone who wants the upside.

Room to grow. As Feight scales, this seat scales with it. If things go well, today's Growth Lead becomes tomorrow's Head of Growth with a team underneath.

Fair, direct treatment. Clear expectations, no politics, predictable payments. We treat people running important parts of our business like partners.

Remote work with autonomy. Work on your own rhythm as long as the work ships and the numbers move.



To apply:



Start your message with the word PLAYBOOK on the first line, so we know you read the post. Anything without it gets skipped.



Then send us:



A short video, 1 to 2 minutes, where you introduce yourself. Who you are, what you've done, and why this role caught your attention.

Three samples of content you've personally created. At least one of them should be video.

Two or three B2B results you've personally driven. Numbers, links, before and after. The harder the proof, the better.

Your full AI stack for marketing work. What tools you actually use for content, funnels, design, copy, ads, research, anything else. We want to see the whole setup, not just one tool.



Generic copy-paste applications get skipped. We would rather wait than fill the seat with the wrong person.



Next steps:



Here's what happens after you send your application:



We'll get back to you within 5 business days.

If your application makes it through the first filter, we'll send you a short trial task. It should take less than an hour.

The top candidates from that round move on to an interview with the founder.



All the best,



FEIGHT AI Team.

title: Online Business Project Coordinator
description:
For Health Coaching / Online Education Brand

Paid Mini Test ? Long-Term Part-Time Role



I’m looking for a highly organized online business project coordinator to help me organize the online coaching / online education side of my business.



This is a project-management-heavy role with marketing and funnel awareness. I am not looking for someone to only schedule posts or complete random admin tasks. I need someone who can help organize moving pieces, track projects, coordinate with my copywriter and clinic coordinator, manage documents, map funnels, and help me turn scattered ideas into clear, executable steps.



I run an established in-person acupuncture / Chinese medicine clinic, and I’m slowly building the online coaching / online education side of my business.



I’m also a full-time clinician, busy mom to a 2 year old, creative business owner/online content creator, and I have ADHD, so I often have a lot of ideas moving at once. At the same time, I’m building this in a realistic season of life. I am not looking for someone who pushes me to move faster just for the sake of moving fast. I need someone who can help me capture my ideas, organize them, prioritize what matters, and turn them into clear next steps without making everything feel urgent or overwhelming and I can take better action. My focus these days is everywhere, so keep me in check.



This role will start small because the online side of the business is still in the startup / buildout phase. I’m being thoughtful with budget and capacity, but I am looking for someone long-term. If the fit is strong and the online business grows, this role can grow in hours, responsibility, and pay over time.



About the Role



I’m one online creator / founder building the online education and coaching side of my business while still running my in-person clinic.



This is not a big corporate team or a fully built-out company with perfect systems. It’s me, my ideas, my content, my offers, and a small support team around me.



You’ll be working closely with me side by side, helping me organize the moving pieces, capture ideas, track next steps, and make sure things don’t fall through the cracks.



I need someone who is comfortable over-communicating in a helpful way. I would rather you ask, clarify, confirm, and update me than quietly disappear or assume.



A big part of this role is helping me take what’s in my head and turn it into something visible, organized, and actionable.



This could look like:



Listening to a Loom or voice note and turning it into a clean plan

Organizing scattered Google Docs across different accounts

Finding duplicate files and recommending the master version

Creating project trackers

Coordinating with my copywriter

Touching base with my clinic coordinator when needed

Checking what still needs my decision

Reminding me what’s pending

Helping me prioritize what actually matters next

About the Stage of the Business



This role is for someone who is comfortable joining during the startup / buildout phase of the online side of my business.



My in-person clinic is established, but the online coaching / online education side is still being built. That means the systems are not perfect yet. Some documents live in different Google Drives. Some projects are still in idea form. Some funnels are still being mapped. My signature system and coaching container are still being organized.



That is part of why I’m hiring.



I need someone who is not intimidated by a business that is still taking shape. I need someone who can help bring structure, clarity, and follow-through while things are being built.



This is not a polished corporate role where everything is already systemized. This is a chance to help build the operating system of a growing online health coaching / education brand from the ground up.



I already have support from a copywriter and clinic coordinator, and this role will involve helping coordinate between people, projects, tools, documents, and ideas.



The role will start lean, around 5–10 hours per week, because I am being thoughtful with budget and capacity. But I am looking for someone long-term. If the fit is strong and the online business grows, there is room for this role to grow in hours, responsibility, and pay over time.



Who I’m Looking For



You are not just a task-taker.



You are a systems thinker, strong communicator, and organized follow-through person. You can take a messy brain dump and turn it into a clean plan, project tracker, funnel map, folder system, or task list.



You are proactive. You notice what’s missing. You follow up without being asked. You over-communicate in a helpful way. You can manage up and keep me updated without me having to chase you.



I need someone who can help organize the chaos without killing the creativity.



Personality-wise, I’m looking for someone warm, steady, intuitive, organized, and marketing-minded. Someone who can bring calm to the chaos, help me see the big picture, and keep things moving without adding pressure. Tell me when things are time sensitive and what I need to get ahead of. I want to be able to turn off from work at times to be a present mom because you are handling it. 



Experience with online health coaches, online educators, wellness brands, course creators, or service-based online businesses is strongly preferred.



This Role Is For Someone Who Can Help With

Project Management & Online Operations



You will help organize the online side of the business so projects do not live only in my brain.



This may include:



Turning messy ideas, Loom videos, voice notes, and brain dumps into organized plans

Creating and updating project trackers

Mapping out what exists, what is missing, and what needs attention

Keeping projects moving across the team

Tracking deadlines, owners, links, assets, and next steps

Following up with me and other tea
mbers when something is pending

Creating simple SOPs and repeatable workflows

Helping me see the big picture so I can execute

Giving me simple updates on what is done, what is missing, and what needs my decision

Google Drive / Document Organization



A big part of this role will be helping me organize documents across multiple Google Drives and
 accounts.



Some of my materials currently live in my personal
, some in my social media / online business
, and some in my clinic
. I also have duplicate documents because I’m building this business while in a mentorship and while running my clinic.



I need someone who can help audit where everything lives, identify duplicates, recommend the correct “source of truth,” organize files into clean folders, and create a system so future documents are easier to find.



This may include:



Auditing Google Drive folders across multiple accounts

Identifying duplicate documents

Creating a master document inventory

Recommending which version should become the master file

Creating a clean folder structure for the online coaching / education business

Separating clinic, social media, and coaching offer materials

Creating archive folders instead of deleting files

Linking important documents into a master tracker

Coordinating with my copywriter to make sure copy docs,
s, landing pages, and launch assets are saved and tracked correctly

Helping organize my signature system / coaching framework so I can see the big picture and finish building it



Important: I do not want files deleted without approval. I prefer archiving and reviewing before anything is removed.



Signature System / Coaching Container Organization



I’m still building out my signature system, coaching container, and step-by-step process for the online side of the business.



I need help organizing my ideas into a visible structure.



This may include helping me organize:



Core promise

Ideal client

Signature method / framework

Step-by-step process

Client journey

Program modules

Worksheets and homework

Client resources

 and sales copy

Questions that need my decision



You do not need to create my intellectual property for me. I need someone who can help me organize my thoughts, documents, and ideas so I can actually finish building the offer.



Marketing & Funnel Systems



You should understand online health coaching, online education, funnels, lead magnets,
s, and content flow.



You will help with:



Mapping funnels and customer journeys

Checking that social media CTAs connect to the right ManyChat flow, lead magnet,
 sequence, and offer

Reviewing
 sequences to make sure everything is complete and ready to go

Making sure
s are uploaded correctly in Kit / ConvertKit

Eventually helping with GoHighLevel / GHL setup and organization once I move into that platform

Checking subject lines, preview text, links, buttons, tags, triggers, automations, and delivery flows

Flagging missing links, broken steps, unclear CTAs, or gaps in the customer journey

Updating me with what is done, what is missing, what needs my decision, and what has already been followed up on



My copywriter may create the
s and landing page copy, but you will help make sure everything is complete, organized, uploaded, connected, tested, and ready to go.



I need someone who can tell me:



“Here’s what’s done. Here’s what’s missing. Here’s what needs your decision. Here’s what I already followed up on.”



Social Media Operations



You will not be responsible for being the entire creative strategist, but you may help organize and manage the backend of social content.



This may include:



Organizing content ideas, captions, hooks, video files, B-roll, thumbnails, and assets

Keeping the content calendar updated

Tracking what has been filmed, edited, posted, scheduled, or repurposed

Making sure social captions and CTAs match the correct link, keyword, lead magnet, or funnel

Coordinating with my copywriter, video editor, designer, or other tea
mbers

Helping ensure content connects to
 list growth, lead magnets, and offers

Helping organize social media workflows so content does not get lost

Future Client Delivery Systems



I am building a future online coaching offer, so I also need help organizing the backend for future coaching clients.



This may include:



Creating organized Google Drive / Dropbox folder structures for future coaching clients

Building a repeatable client folder template

Creating systems for intake forms, assessments, session notes, action plans, client resources, and progress tracking

Organizing client-facing vs. internal folders

Creating file naming conventions

Creating a master client tracker

Helping document the client onboarding and delivery process



The goal is to make sure future coaching clients have a clean, professional backend experience and that nothing gets lost.



Team Coordination



You will coordinate with:



My copywriter, who is very organized and owns much of the copy / messaging flow

My clinic coordinator, who supports the in-person clinic side

Other contractors such as editors, designers, or VAs as needed



You should be comfortable checking in, clarifying next steps, documenting decisions, and making sure nothing falls through the cracks.



Must-Have Experience



Please only apply if you have experience with:



ManyChat

Kit / ConvertKit

GoHighLevel / GHL experience, even though I do not currently have GHL yet

Online health coaching, online education, course creators, wellness brands, or service-based online businesses

Google Drive / Google Docs organization

Project management or operations coordination



You do not need to be a world-class expert in every tool, but you must understand how funnels,
 systems, automations, tags, links, lead magnets, and customer journeys connect.



Helpful Experience



Experience with any of the following is a plus:



Zapier



Payhip

Kajabi, ThriveCart, or membership platforms

Squarespace or WordPress

Notion, ClickUp, Trello, Asana, or Google Sheets

Google Drive / Dropbox

Canva

Metricool or social scheduling tools

Instagram,
, TikTok, YouTube Shorts

Loom

AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude, or similar

You’re a Great Fit If

You are hyper-detail-oriented

You are proactive, not reactive

You communicate clearly and consistently

You can manage up and follow up with me when needed

You are comfortable with a creative, ADHD business owner

You can take messy information and organize it

You notice missing pieces before I do

You understand funnels, lead generation, and online education

You are comfortable documenting systems

You can work independently after receiving context

You are looking for a long-term role that can grow over time

You can help create calm and clarity, not more pressure

You enjoy helping founders organize the messy middle

This Is Not a Fit If

You need constant direction to stay on task

You disappear when things get quiet

You say yes to everything but do not follow through

You wait for every tiny instruction before taking action

You are uncomfortable working with imperfect information

You struggle to communicate clearly

You only want simple admin tasks

You have no experience with ManyChat, Kit / ConvertKit, or GHL

You are not comfortable coordinating with other tea
mbers

You need everything to already be perfectly organized before you can help

You only want to join a business where all systems are already fully built and documented

Paid Mini Test



This role starts with a small paid mini test.



Pay: $20 fixed

Deadline: 24 hours after receiving materials

Format: Google Doc preferred

Logins: No logins required for the test



I will send you a short Loom video and/or short business overview where I explain the current state of my online business, what I’m building, and what feels messy.



Please watch the Loom and create one simple Google Doc with:



A clean summary of what you understand

The main projects / moving pieces you heard

A simple project tracker or priority list

Anything that sounds missing, unclear, duplicated, disconnected, or at risk of being dropped

The questions you would ask me next

A sample weekly update you would send me if you were managing this ongoing



I do not need a complicated system. I want to see how you think, organize, communicate, and bring clarity to messy information.



Part of this test is seeing how well you can work with imperfect information, organize the chaos, and tell me what needs to happen next.



Ongoing Role & Pay



If the paid mini test goes well, this can grow into an ongoing part-time role.



Starting structure:



5–10 hours/week to start

$10–$12/hr depending on experience

Potential to grow to 10–20 hours/week

Potential rate increase as ownership grows



This role will start small because I am still figuring out exactly what support I need. But if the person is a strong fit, organized, proactive, and truly helps me move forward with less mental overwhelm, I would love for this to become a long-term role.



To Apply



Put the word FLOWER in your subject line. If it’s missing, your application will not be reviewed.



Please send a 2–3 minute talking head video using Loom or a similar tool. Include your Loom link directly in your application message. 



In your video, please cover as much as you can:



Who you are and something personal about you

Your experience with ManyChat, Kit / ConvertKit, and GHL

Your experience with online health coaching, online educators, course creators, or wellness brands

Your experience organizing Google Drive / Google Docs, project trackers, or messy business systems

How you use AI in your work and where you draw the line

Why this role interests you

An example of a time you took messy information and turned it into an organized system, tracker, funnel map, folder structure, or plan

What you love to do for fun!

Your hourly rate and weekly availability



Applications without a video will not be considered.

US Panels is a growing insulated metal panel (IMP) manufacturer serving cold storage, warehouse, food processing, data center, and industrial construction markets. We are building a content engine that educates the construction industry, drives inbound traffic, and establishes US Panels as the go-to authority in our space.

The AI Content Creator is responsible for producing the full range of assets that power our marketing: written articles, blogs, newsletters, social copy, AI-generated images, and video content. This is a modern content role built around AI-assisted workflows — you will use today's best AI tools to create high volumes of quality content efficiently, without sacrificing accuracy, brand voice, or technical credibility. You are creative, organized, and genuinely excited about what AI tools can do when put in the right hands.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



AI-Assisted Written Content

• Produce blog posts, technical articles, and long-form guides (1,500–3,000+ words) using AI writing tools — drafted with AI, refined by you.

Video Content Production

Newsletters &

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

title: Content Workflow & Systems VA (No Video Editing, No Strategy)
description:
READ THIS FIRST – THIS IS A SYSTEMS ROLE (NO VIDEO EDITING, NO STRATEGY)



If you want to be a “creative” or editor, this is NOT the job for you.



I’m Stefan, founder of Status Alpha – a high-ticket mentorship for men who want elite body, energy, mindset and performance.



I have already built a detailed Content Operating System (Google Drive structure, Content Tracker, SOPs, Loom trainings). I shoot content and drop it into a Drive INBOX. I need a Content Workflow & Systems VA who loves structure and can run the machine so I don’t have to think about it.



Your mission: take every video I drop into Drive and, using my SOPs, turn it into organized assets and scheduled posts across Instagram,
, TikTok, YouTube and LinkedIn.



This is FULL-TIME and LONG-TERM for someone in the Philippines with very strong written English and experience supporting coaches/creators.



WHAT THIS JOB IS (YOUR DAILY WORK)



You will NOT do video editing.

You will NOT design graphics.

You will NOT invent content strategy.



You WILL:



1) Handle content intake & organization

– Check a Google Drive INBOX for new videos.

– Move files into the correct folders (RAW, PROOF, Stefan Asset Bank).

– Create/update rows in a Google Sheets Content Tracker (AssetID, file path, type, status, transcript level, etc.).



2) Create and clean transcripts

– Upload videos to transcription tools.

– Paste transcripts into Google Docs.

– Fix grammar, misheard words, punctuation and formatting so they read like a native wrote them (especially for testimonials, VSLs and “hero” videos).



3) Build editor briefs and manage revisions

– Use AI tools + my prompts to generate editor briefs.

– Copy the brief into a Clip Brief template (Google Doc).

– Fill in Meta info (source file links, goals, etc.).

– Add simple thumbnail notes (text + which folder to pull photos from).

– Coordinate with the editor:

  • Move status from Raw ? Briefed ? Editing ? Needs Revision ? Approved.

  • Watch drafts, write clear revision notes, and approve final versions.



4) Schedule and publish content (NO editing)

– Take finished assets from the “Approved” folders.

– Schedule posts in:

  • Meta Business Suite (IG/FB)

  • TikTok Scheduler

  • YouTube Studio

  • LinkedIn native scheduler

– Use provided captions/CTAs and make sure dates/times and platforms are correct.



5) Log performance monthly

– Once a month, open platform Insights.

– Add the top performing posts to a “Viral_Log” sheet (URL, views, saves, etc.).

– Write 3–10 simple bullet-point learnings (patterns), NOT complex analytics.



You will get Looms and written SOPs for all of this. Your job is to FOLLOW them, IMPROVE small things, and KEEP EVERYTHING ON TIME.



WHAT THIS JOB IS NOT



– NOT a video editor role (if you want to edit, don’t apply).

– NOT a “content manager / strategist” role.

– NOT a social media “ideas” job.

– NOT part-time or side-gig work.



This is a **workflow / systems VA** role. Think operations, not creativity.



REQUIREMENTS (MUST-HAVES)



– Written English: 9/10 or close (without AI).

  • You can fix transcripts and captions so they read like a native wrote them.

  • You notice grammar, spelling and punctuation mistakes on your own.



– Experience supporting at least ONE coach/creator/personal brand with:

  • Google Drive organization

  • Content calendars / trackers

  • Editor/creative coordination

  • Scheduling posts on multiple platforms



– You actually LIKE:

  • SOPs

  • Loom trainings

  • Checklists

  • Keeping things clean and consistent



– Comfortable with:

  • Google Drive / Docs / Sheets

  • Meta Business Suite / basic platform schedulers

  • Simple video tools ONLY for transcripts and checking (CapCut auto captions, YouTube transcripts, etc.)



– Extremely organized and detail-oriented:

  • You don’t “forget” to update the sheet.

  • You keep folders clean.

  • You follow processes exactly and suggest improvements once you understand them.



SCHEDULE & PAY



– Hours: around 35–40 hours per week

– Time: mostly PH evenings (to overlap with US time) + light weekend coverage (1–3 hours on Sat/Sun for checks/scheduling)

– Pay: USD $500–700/month long term, depending on how well you can run the system



This is a long-term role. If we’re a good fit, I want you in this seat for 12+ months.



WHO THIS IS FOR



– You like being the person who “keeps everything moving.”

– You get satisfaction from a clean Drive, up-to-date tracker, and posts going out on time.

– You want a stable, full-time role with clear expectations where you can become “the person who runs the content machine.”



WHO THIS IS NOT FOR



– You want to be a video editor, creator or strategist.

– You only want 10–20 hours/week or short-term work.

– You dislike repetitive tasks, even when they matter.

– You are not strong in written English.



HOW TO APPLY (FOLLOW EXACTLY)



Use this subject line / OnlineJobs title:

CONTENT WORKFLOW VA – [Your First Name]



In your message, include **short answers** to:



1) Experience:

– Briefly describe the BEST coach/creator you worked with and what you did for their content day-to-day (max 5 sentences).



2) Transcripts & English:

– On a scale of 1–10, how strong is your WRITTEN English (without AI)?

– In 3–5 sentences, tell me why you can be trusted to fix transcripts for important videos (testimonials, VSLs, live trainings).



3) Tools:

– Which tools have you used for:

  a) Transcription

  b) Scheduling posts

  c) Google Drive organization

  d) Video review / basic checks (CapCut/YT, etc.)



4) Hours & Pay:

– How many hours/week can you commit?

– Are you able to work PH evenings + some weekend time?

– What monthly salary (within the $500–700 range) would you be happy with long-term?



5) Proof:

– Links or screenshots from ONE coach/creator you supported (social accounts, a Drive structure screenshot with names blurred, or anything that shows you’ve done this kind of work).



Applications that do not follow these steps will be ignored.



I’m looking for ONE person who wants to own this role long-term and run the system with pride.

title: Lead Generation and Business Development Specialist
description:
US Panels — Job Description

Lead Generation & Business Development Specialist



Type: Full-Time · Remote

Experience: 3–5 Years

Industry: Commercial Construction / Building Materials



Web Scraping   ·  
 Campaigns   ·   Cold Outreach   ·   CRM Management   ·   Pipeline Reporting



ROLE OVERVIEW



US Panels manufactures insulated metal panel (IMP) systems used in cold storage, warehouses, food processing plants, data centers, and industrial buildings. Our customers are the contractors, developers, engineers, and facility owners who design and build these projects across North America.

The Lead Generation & Business Development Specialist is the engine behind our outbound pipeline. This is a high-activity, data-driven role built for someone who is equal parts researcher, communicator, and organizer. You will identify new industry verticals, build targeted prospect lists through web scraping and research, execute multi-channel outbound campaigns, and ensure every qualified lead is captured and tracked in the CRM. You work closely with the content team and sales team to keep messaging sharp and pipeline moving.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



Web Scraping & List Building

• Identify and research new industry verticals and geographic markets for outbound prospecting (cold storage developers, food processing contractors, industrial GCs, data center builders, warehouse owners, etc.).

• Use web scraping tools and research platforms to compile accurate, targeted contact lists — names, titles, company,
, phone, and LinkedIn.

• Leverage tools such as LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo, ZoomInfo, Hunter.io, or similar platforms to source and verify contact data.

• Continuously expand and refresh prospect databases as new verticals are identified or existing lists age out.

• Segment lists by industry vertical, company size, geography, and decision-maker role to enable precise targeting.


 Campaign Execution

• Build and launch outbound
 sequences targeting segmented prospect lists — cold outreach, follow-ups, and re-engagement campaigns.

• Write or customize campaign copy in coordination with the content team to ensure messaging is relevant, personable, and aligned with current marketing initiatives.

• A/B test subject lines,
 copy, and calls to action to continuously improve open rates and reply rates.

• Monitor deliverability, bounce rates, unsubscribes, and replies; maintain list hygiene and CAN-SPAM compliance.

• Coordinate send timing, frequency, and segmentation to avoid audience fatigue and maximize response.

B2B Outreach — Cold
, Cold Call & LinkedIn

• Execute high-volume, personalized outbound outreach across three channels:
, phone, and LinkedIn.

• Make introductory calls to
-engaged prospects to qualify interest and move them toward a sales conversation.

• Send personalized LinkedIn connection requests and follow-up messages to targeted contacts at priority accounts.

• Maintain a consistent daily outreach cadence and log all activity in the CRM without exception.

• Represent US Panels professionally and build genuine rapport — you are the first human impression for most prospects.

Lead Capture & CRM Entry

• Enter all new contacts, outreach activity, responses, and lead status updates into the CRM accurately and promptly.

• Qualify inbound leads from the website and digital campaigns before passing to the sales team.

• Document lead context thoroughly at the time of handoff: company background, project type, timeline, decision-maker, and any expressed needs.

• Ensure zero leads fall through the cracks — own follow-up cadences until a lead is disqualified or handed off.

Cross-Team Collaboration

• Work closely with the content team to align outbound messaging with active campaigns, blog content, and downloadable assets.

• Coordinate with the sales team on target account priorities, territory coverage, and feedback on lead quality.

• Share insights on which verticals, messages, and contact types are responding so both teams can adapt quickly.

• Participate in regular pipeline and campaign review meetings.

Reporting & Analytics

• Report weekly on outreach volume, open rates, reply rates, calls made, meetings booked, and leads entered into the CRM.

• Track pipeline value generated from BDR-sourced leads and report on conversion at each stage.

• Identify what is working across channels, verticals, and messaging — and what is not — and bring recommendations to the team.

• Maintain a clean, organized view of campaign performance in the CRM and reporting dashboards.



REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE



Lead Generation & Sales

• 3–5 years of experience in a BDR, SDR, lead generation, or outbound sales role.

• Proven track record building prospect lists from scratch and converting cold outreach into qualified pipeline.

• Experience selling into or prospecting construction, building materials, manufacturing, or industrial B2B markets is strongly preferred.

Data Scraping & Research

• Hands-on experience using web scraping tools, data enrichment platforms, or research workflows to build contact lists.

• Proficiency with Apollo, ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Hunter.io, or comparable prospecting tools.

• Ability to identify the right contacts within target companies and verify data accuracy before outreach.


 Marketing & Outreach

• Experience writing and executing outbound
 campaigns using HubSpot, Mailchimp, Apollo, Outreach, or similar platforms.

• Comfortable crafting personalized, concise outreach that does not read like a mass
.

• Familiarity with
 deliverability, list hygiene, and CAN-SPAM compliance basics.

CRM & Data Entry

• Proficient in HubSpot, Pipedrive, Salesforce, or a comparable CRM platform.

• Meticulous about data accuracy — contact records, activity logs, and pipeline stages are always current and correct.

• Highly organized; able to manage large lists, multi-touch cadences, and concurrent campaigns without losing track.

Communication & Collaboration

• Strong written communication — outreach
s are clear, personable, and compelling.

• Comfortable on the phone; able to build rapport quickly with busy construction professionals.

• Collaborative team player who communicates proactively with content and sales counterparts.



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS



• Experience prospecting into cold storage, food processing, data center, or warehouse construction markets.

• Familiarity with commercial construction project timelines and procurement decision-making.

• Exposure to trade shows or industry associations (AGC, GCCA, IARW, BOMA).

• Experience with LinkedIn outreach automation tools (Lemlist, Dripify, or similar).



TOOLS USED IN THIS ROLE



Apollo / ZoomInfo / Hunter.io   ·   LinkedIn Sales Navigator   ·   HubSpot or Pipedrive CRM



Outreach / Lemlist or similar   ·   Mailchimp / HubSpot
   ·   Google Sheets / Workspace



PERFORMANCE METRICS



• Qualified prospects added to CRM per week and month.

• Outbound
 open rates, reply rates, and positive response rates.

• Cold calls made and conversion to booked conversations.

• Meetings booked and handed off to the sales team.

• Pipeline value generated from outbound-sourced leads.



HOW TO APPLY



Please submit the following:

1. Resume or CV

2. Brief description of the industries you have prospected into and the tools you used.

3. An example of an outbound
 or campaign sequence you wrote (anonymized if needed).



Applicants with demonstrated success building pipeline from cold outreach in technical or industrial B2B markets will be strongly preferred.

This is a long-term role. We're looking for someone who wants to build a career with one company, not someone looking for the next gig in 6 months. If that's you, keep reading.

Monitor and respond to client messages on Slack and Microsoft Teams, with live coverage during the daily US overlap window and 8 to 10 hour response time outside of it

Use our SOPs and account context to respond to routine account questions independently

Prepare weekly performance summaries for clients. We have templates and a reporting framework

2 to 4 years working with US Amazon clients at an agency or in-house at an Amazon brand

You've independently owned client accounts, not just assisted on them

$7 to $10/hr starting rate based on experience, with formal review at 90 days

Clear growth path: part-time to full-time, coordinator to senior coordinator to account manager

Direct working relationship with the founder, not buried under layers of management

Small team where your work is seen and your voice matters

Paid Philippine public holidays

Send us a Loom video (3 to 4 minutes max) where you answer these three questions in order:

description:

If your school requires official documentation for academic credit, we coordinate directly with your institution.

If you perform, you are first in line when a paid VA position opens. We hire from within.

We organize our internship positions into three tiers.

???? Green — Actively recruiting each term:

Graphic Designer — You work in Canva daily and have a portfolio that shows it. You design social media graphics, event banners, marketing assets, and YouTube thumbnails for real programs with real audiences. If your work is strong, it goes live immediately.

Copyeditor — You catch what others miss. You edit student essays, program materials, and organizational communications with precision and consistency. Chicago Manual of Style is not a stranger to you. Strong English is non-negotiable.

Media Editor — You edit video with real software, not just phone apps. You produce polished short-form content, event highlights, and branded video assets. A portfolio with actual edited footage is required.



???? Yellow — Limited placement for exceptional candidates, irregular availability:

Web Developer — You have built or significantly maintained a real website and can show it.

Personal Assistant — You are exceptionally organized, proactive, and comfortable supporting a fast-moving executive directly.

Events Coordinator — You have coordinated a real event from planning through execution and can walk us through what you did.

Tutor — You have subject mastery in English, writing, or speech and debate and genuine teaching instinct.



???? Red — VA services exist in these roles. We do not host interns here:

Accounts Technician

Data Analyst

Administrative Assistant

Software Developer



What You Need

You are currently enrolled in a college or university in the Philippines. You are at least a second-year student. You have a stable internet connection: minimum 30 Mbps download, 5 Mbps upload, under 50 ms ping. You have a dedicated workspace and a working laptop or desktop. Sessions and check-ins are live on camera. A bad connection wastes everyone's time.



What You Get

This is paid work. You earn 100 PHP per hour from day one. You build a real portfolio on real programs. You receive a certificate of completion from Leaders Academy. If your institution requires official internship documentation for academic credit, we coordinate directly with your school. And if you perform, you are first in line when a VA position opens. We hire from within.



How to Apply

Complete our application form:

Attentiveness Check

Write "Twenty" in your subject line. This tells us you read the full posting. Applications without it will not be reviewed. 



One Last Thing

If you are looking for easy hours without doing real work, this is not the right fit. The internship structure is designed to show us what you can do and help you grow. We will know within the first two weeks.

title: Dropship Dispute Manager — Experience REQUIRED
description:
Looking for an experienced Dispute Manager to own our chargeback and

  payment dispute workflow. Your mission is simple: win disputes,

  reduce loss rate, protect our merchant standing across payment

  processors.



  THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR BEGINNERS. We only consider applicants who can

  demonstrably show previous dropship store experience handling

  disputes and chargebacks.

  

  What you'll do:

  You'll monitor all incoming chargebacks and disputes daily. Every dispute

  that comes in becomes your responsibility — gathering evidence,

  constructing the response narrative, submitting before deadlines. contact the customer to resolve the issue.

  

  Your evidence packages need to be airtight: delivery proof,

  tracking screenshots, customer communication logs, signed agreements

  where applicable, product descriptions matching what was delivered.

  You know what payment processors look for, and you build responses

  that win.



The highest priority at all times is to contact customers as quickly as possible when a dispute, chargeback, or complaint is received. The goal is to resolve issues directly with the customer before they escalate further.



Because of this, strong customer support experience is essential. You must be able to communicate professionally, clearly, and in a customer friendly manner via
. Excellent written English is required, as a large part of the role involves communicating with customers, resolving concerns, and finding solutions that prevent disputes from escalating.



Performance bonuses are directly linked to successful dispute prevention, customer retention, and resolving customer issues quickly and professionally. We are looking for someone who takes ownership, acts fast, and has a proven track record of reducing chargebacks through proactive customer communication.

  

  You'll track every outcome — which disputes won, which lost, why.

  trigger disputes, which customer segments dispute most, which

  shipping methods cause friendly fraud. You'll feed those patterns

  back to ownership so we can fix the upstream causes, not just chase

  downstream symptoms. 

  

  Weekly you'll report dispute volume, win rate, and trends. You're

  the last line of defense between us and unnecessary losses, and

  you'll be measured (and bonused) on the wins you bring in.

  

  What you must have:

  • Proven previous experience as Dispute Manager in a dropship store
