title: B2B Content & Social Media Manager (Video + Ads)
description:
Read this first

I'm hiring one person to take over our content, social media and ads. If you're a content creator at heart who likes the marketing game and can ship every day without being chased, keep reading.



About Feight AI

We build custom AI solutions for manufacturers in Central Europe doing over €1M in annual revenue. The technical side is now staffed. I run sales, strategy and client relationships myself. What's missing is the engine that produces content, runs the social channels, and brings inbound interest from manufacturing decision-makers.

This is a blank canvas. No content, no funnel, no paid presence yet. The person we hire defines what good marketing at Feight AI looks like from scratch, with me holding the strategic frame and you producing the actual work.

What matters most

The single most important skill is content creation, especially video. Our organic growth across Meta, LinkedIn, YouTube and our blog depends on it, and our paid ads only work if the creative is strong. You produce content yourself, every day, consistently. That's the heart of this role.

Second to that is marketing sense. Enough to look at our numbers and tell me what's working and what isn't, and enough to have a real conversation about strategy. I hold the strategic frame. You execute and bring proposals.

What you'll be doing day to day



Producing 1 to 2 social posts per day, every working day, across our channels (Meta, LinkedIn, YouTube, blog). Mix of text, graphics, and video.

Creating short video content regularly. Editing, voiceover, visuals. This is the most important muscle.

Running Meta Ads when we launch them.

Building simple landing pages when needed for campaigns or lead magnets.

Tracking what works. You watch the numbers across channels and tell me what's worth doubling down on.



You probably



Create content yourself as your main skill, especially video. You can show us examples.

Have a marketing brain. Enough strategy sense to discuss what we should try next and why.

Are organized and self-directing. You ship every day without being chased.

Have a strong work ethic. If you say you'll publish something, it goes out, on time, at the quality you promised.

Learn fast. If you don't know LinkedIn Ads or a particular landing page tool yet, you figure it out in a week.

Communicate in English clearly and professionally.

Use AI tools daily for the actual work. We expect this, not just talk about it.

Want to earn more through results, not hours. The base is steady. The bonus is where it gets interesting.



This isn't a fit if



You don't personally create content. You manage other creators or "also write."

You can't be consistent. You need someone to chase you every day to ship.

You're motivated mainly by hourly pay, not by performance.

You expect detailed onboarding and three months to figure out the basics.



What we offer



$1,500/month base, paid reliably and on time.

Performance bonus tied to qualified leads and closed revenue. If your work drives sales, the bonus has no upper limit. This role exists for someone who wants the upside.

Room to grow. As Feight scales, this seat scales with it. Today's content + social manager becomes tomorrow's head of marketing with a team.

Fair, direct treatment. Clear expectations, no politics, predictable payments. We treat the people running important parts of our business like partners.

Remote work with autonomy. Work on your own rhythm as long as the work ships and the numbers move.



To apply

Start your message with the word PLAYBOOK on the first line, so we know you read the post. Anything without it gets skipped.



Then send us:



A short video, 1 to 2 minutes, where you introduce yourself. Who you are, what you've done, why this role caught your attention.

Three samples of content you've personally created. At least one of them should be video.

One or two examples of B2B or business marketing work you've done before. Show us what you've shipped and the thinking behind it.

Your full AI stack for marketing work. What tools you actually use for content, video, design, copy, ads, research. We want to see the whole setup, not just one tool.



Generic copy-paste applications get skipped. We would rather wait than fill the seat with the wrong person.

Next steps

Here's what happens after you send your application:



We'll get back to you within 5 business days.

If your application makes it through the first filter, we'll send you a short trial task. It should take less than an hour.

The top candidates from that round move on to an interview with the founder.



All the best,

FEIGHT AI Team

title: Automation Specialist Needed to Build Credit Repair Client Onboarding System
description:
We are looking for an experienced automation specialist to help build out a complete automated onboarding system for our credit repair business.

* 

* Zapier

* GoHighLevel / GHL

* Text/email automation sequences

When a new client joins our paid Skool group, they should receive an automatic DM with clear onboarding instructions.



The message should tell them to:



* Introduce themselves

* Complete the onboarding form

* Understand support hours and next steps



From there, the client should complete a

 forms and boards

* 
 onboarding form built

* 
 board organized for new client submissions

 to GHL

The goal is to create a fully automated backend system where a client can purchase, join the community, complete onboarding, get added to the CRM, receive next steps, and start receiving automated education without us having to manually manage every step.

title: STR Bookkeeper
description:
DO NOT APPLY IF YOU HAVEN'T BEEN A BOOKKEEPER AT A SHORT TERM RENTAL/VACATION RENTAL COMPANY



Role: Bookkeeper

We are a fast-growing vacation rental management company looking to add a Bookkeeping Admin to our team for the long term. As we scale, clean books are what keep our owners confident, our vendors reliable, and our business compliant. This role supports our financial back office: keeping expenses clean and categorized, validating and scheduling vendor payments, helping file occupancy taxes on time, and helping make sure owner statements are accurate before they go out. You also support supply ordering and other items the team and properties need. You support the bookkeeping before it reaches our accountant, so accuracy and follow-through matter here more than almost anywhere else in the company. This is a detail role for someone who has done this in short-term rentals before and understands owner statements, trust accounting, pass-through expenses, and occupancy tax.

Responsibilities

Review, code, and categorize all expenses and daily transactions, including reservation adjustments for discounts, altered stays, and refunds

Validate vendor payments before release, matching them to Breezeway work orders and approvals and confirming the work, amount, and rate are correct

Schedule and process vendor payments so nothing goes past due, and keep vendor records current

Prepare and file transient occupancy tax (TOT) returns and ready financial data for tax filings, keeping us compliant in every jurisdiction

Confirm the right occupancy tax rates and charge amounts are set across OTAs and direct bookings, and flag any gaps

Support the ordering of supplies and other items, tracking purchases against the right accounts

Support the owner statement review each cycle, checking for accuracy before statements go out

Reconcile all company and owner accounts in QBO and tie balances out to your PMS

Catch and resolve duplicate charges, missing receipts, and miscoded items, and keep clean documentation for every transaction

Support month-end close and the owner statement run

Results

Owner statements reviewed and ready by the 10th of each month

Owner-reported statement errors: 0 per cycle

Vendor payments past due or released with the wrong amount: 0 per month

TOT returns filed by their due date: 0 late filings

Uncategorized or unreconciled transactions at month-end close: 0

Requirements

Prior bookkeeping or AP experience inside vacation rental or short-term rental property management, non-negotiable

Experience with TopKey, or with expense tracking for a larger vacation rental management company

Hands-on QuickBooks Online (QBO) experience

Proficient in Google Workspace, including Sheets for data analysis and reporting

Experience in a short-term rental PMS, Streamline or Guesty required

Familiar with Breezeway work orders, and Notion for documentation

Experience preparing and filing TOT or lodging taxes, and familiar with how OTAs collect and remit occupancy tax

Understands owner statements, trust accounting, and the difference between owner-billable, company, and pass-through expenses

High attention to detail and able to self-check before anything leaves your desk

Organized and consistent with documentation

Comfortable building your own checklists and SOPs to work more efficiently and to guide others

What Success Looks Like in 90 Days

30 days: comfortable handling and categorizing all transactions, and paying some vendors

60 days: supporting owner statement reviews and understanding the TOT filing calendar

90 days: helping with month-end categorization and catching missing items, and ensuring owner statements are ready by the 10th



Hours: M-F 8-5 PST - 45 hours per week



Pay: $1,365 per month paid out on the 15th and 30th of the month

Wifi and VPN Stipend of $30 per month paid out as $15 on each paycheck



13th month awarded based on performance and hours worked throughout the year.

title: Revenue Manager, Sierra Sol Elevated Stays
description:

Philippines – Direct Hire (Remote), aligned to U.S. hours



Sierra Sol Elevated Stays is a locally rooted, family-owned property management company serving New Mexico and Texas with 1,000+ vacation rental homes across multiple markets. Our love for these regions is what led us to build Sierra Sol Elevated Stays, focused on providing elevated stays for our guests and elevated stewardship for our homeowners. Our goal is to grow in a way that celebrates what makes our communities special, while delivering elevated experiences for guests and thoughtful, reliable stewardship for homeowners.



Our Elevated Promises

Everything we do is guided by our Elevated Promises. They are our operating standard and the way we earn five-star stays and trusted, long-term homeowner partnerships.



Elevated Guest Engagement: Proactive, elevated hospitality from booking to five-star review.

We believe vacations are special, something people save for, plan for, and look forward to. Our job is to make every stay feel seamless and memorable. We anticipate needs, communicate early, check in during the stay, and resolve issues quickly with warmth and care. Our guest journey is intentionally crafted to deliver the kind of responsiveness, thoughtfulness, and attention to detail that turns great trips into truly elevated experiences.



Elevated Home Stewardship: We care for every home as if it were our own.

As homeowners in our markets, we know what true home stewardship looks like. We operate with a proactive mindset of quality, consistency, and pride. Weekly home checks, rigorous cleaning standards, quality control, seasonal readiness, and preventive maintenance are all part of how we ensure every property is clean, protected, and presentation ready, for guests and for you. We treat every home with the same respect and diligence we expect for our own.



Elevated Homeowner Partnerships: We treat each home like our own investment.

Every homeowner has different goals, maximizing revenue, balancing personal use, focusing on long-term appreciation, or simply enjoying peace of mind. Our role is to be a true partner in those goals, not simply a property manager. As owners and operators in these regions ourselves, our guidance comes from real-world results, not theory. Through regular business reviews, thoughtful design and amenity recommendations, revenue and pricing insights, and brand-building support, we help each property reach its highest potential.



Revenue Management is one of the biggest ways we deliver these promises. This is business partnership work. You are a core part of our team, not an outsourced analyst function.



Job Description - Revenue Manager



Our Revenue Manager owns pricing, fee strategy, and performance analytics across 1,000+ vacation rental homes in New Mexico and Texas. You will maximize homeowner revenue and company profitability through disciplined pricing optimization, thoughtful fee architecture, and clear, data-driven storytelling to homeowners and internal leaders. You will build scalable reporting systems, lead owner business review preparation, and partner closely with Finance (reporting to our CFO), General Managers, Marketing, and Business Development to translate insights into action.



The Revenue Manager will own:

• Pricing strategy across all channels to maximize occupancy, ADR, RevPAR, and Net RevPAR

• Fee strategy to optimize company profitability while protecting guest conversion and homeowner satisfaction

• Owner quarterly and annual business reviews: templates, reporting, insights, and preparation support

• Quarterly market insights reporting by market, including context (weather, events, market shifts) and company and unit performance vs market benchmarks

• Rental Potential Analysis process and templates for prospective homeowners

• Amenity and upgrade ROI recommendations for current homeowners (incremental revenue projections and payback analysis)

• Growth analytics and new homeowner identification using tools like AirDNA, Wheelhouse, Audiences, and our CRM, including lead scoring and data enrichment



Working Hours

This role is full-time and will primarily align to U.S. business hours, expect 4-6 hours overlap with U.S. Central Time zone.

• Core hours: Monday to Friday during U.S. hours with flexibility based on business needs

• Weekly revenue standups and market reviews (standing cadence)

• Light weekend monitoring during peak periods as needed for pacing shifts, promotions, and exception management



Compensation and Incentives

• Base pay: $1,800–$2,300 USD per month (full-time, based on experience, STR revenue expertise, and ability to lead multi-market strategy)

• 13th month pay: Provided in December (prorated for partial years)

• Performance Bonus: Quarterly performance bonus target of 15–20% of base pay (annualized), tied to a scorecard

Location

Our company is building an organic lead generation system, meaning we are **not running paid ads right now**. We need someone who understands how to use GoHighLevel to turn organic traffic from social media, DMs, content, partnerships, webinars, and landing pages into real leads and sales.

 and SMS automation workflows

## Responsibilities

* Set up CRM pipelines for lead tracking

* Build automation workflows using
 and SMS

* GoHighLevel CRM

* GHL funnels and websites

* GHL workflows and automations

*
 and SMS campaigns

* Forms and surveys

* Tags, triggers, and smart lists

* Pipelines and opportunities

* Sales follow-up systems

* Basic funnel strategy

* Understanding how organic traffic can become leads and sales

* Business credit, finance, coaching, digital products, or service-based businesses

* Organic social media lead generation

* Webinar funnels

* Course or digital product funnels

* Stripe/payment setup inside GHL

* Appointment or consultation funnels

* Affiliate or referral tracking

* AI tools inside GoHighLevel

* Reporting and conversion tracking



## What We Are Building



We are building a system where organic marketing creates attention, and GoHighLevel captures and converts that attention into leads and sales.



The process will look like this:



Organic content ? funnel/landing page ? lead form/survey ? automated follow-up ? CRM pipeline ? sales page/payment link ? customer follow-up



Your role is to help build, manage, and improve this system.



## Work Style We Are Looking For

* Proactive

* Strategic

* Organized

* Experienced with GoHighLevel

* Detail-oriented

* Good at solving problems

* Comfortable making recommendations

title: QBO cleanup specialist
description:
## Job Title: QuickBooks Cleanup Specialist & Accountant (QBO Certified / BS or MS in Accounting)

### Job Overview

We are seeking a highly detail-oriented, remote **QuickBooks Online (QBO) Cleanup Specialist** based in the Philippines to rescue and reorganize our financial data.

Our books have a backlog starting from **January of this year**. We need an expert financial detective to jump in, reconcile multiple bank and credit card accounts, correct misclassifications, and optimize our Chart of Accounts. This is a temporary contract project with the potential to transition into a long-term, part-time or full-time bookkeeping role based on performance.

### Key Responsibilities

 * **Backlog & Catch-Up Bookkeeping:** Bring all financial data from January of this year up to the present day entirely up to date.

 * **Account Reconciliation:** Accurately reconcile multiple bank accounts and credit card statements against QuickBooks Online.

 * **Chart of Accounts Optimization:** Review, clean up, and restructure our current Chart of Accounts for better clarity and tax readiness.

 * **Data Categorization:** Audit past transactions to ensure all expenses, income, and transfers are properly and accurately categorized.

 * **Discrepancy Resolution:** Identify, investigate, and resolve any duplicate transactions, missing entries, or un-deposited funds.

### Required Qualifications & Skills

 * **Education:** Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting is **strictly required**. A **Master’s Degree in Accounting** is highly preferred.

 * **Certification:** Must be a **Certified QuickBooks Online ProAdvisor**.

 * **Experience:** Proven track record of successfully handling complex accounting cleanups and catching up on months of messy backlog data.

 * **Attention to Detail:** Exceptional analytical skills with the ability to spot errors and discrepancies quickly.

 * **Communication:** Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

title: Real Estate Media Photo QC, Delivery, and Client Outreach
description:
Are you someone who takes pride in doing detail-oriented work and enjoys having a clear routine with room to handle new things as they come up? Do you like knowing that your work has a direct impact on a real business and its clients? If so, we'd love to have you on our team!



About Us: Avionne Photography is a real estate photography and media business based in Northern New Jersey. We shoot properties for real estate agents and deliver high-quality photos, drone aerials, videos, floor plans, and 3D tours. We run a tight, efficient operation and we're looking for a Virtual Assistant who can help us keep deliveries fast, clients happy, and our pipeline growing.



What You'll Be Doing:

• Photo QC & Delivery: Review completed photos from our editors each morning, do light cleanup in Lightroom, build the property website in our delivery platform, and send finished media to agents on time.

• Retouch Requests: Handle photo revision requests from agents throughout the day, routing and resolving them quickly so nothing sits.

• Client Outreach: During downtime between editing jobs, use our Instagra
thod to send outbound messages and help us connect with potential new clients.

• Booking & Scheduling: Use our booking system to add new agents, schedule shoots, and keep client records accurate.



What We're Looking For:

• Willingness to Work in Eastern Time (9 a.m. to 5 p.m. ET): Our clients are based in the New York metro area, so we need someone who's available and responsive during those hours.

• A Sharp Eye for Detail: Photo quality control is the core of this role. You need to be someone who notices things and takes the time to get it right.

• Reliability & Follow-Through: Our agents count on fast turnaround. We need someone who treats every delivery like it matters — because it does.

• Flexibility & Adaptability: The morning routine is consistent, but the rest of the day can shift. We need someone who can prioritize on the fly and handle what comes up.

• Your Own Adobe Lightroom & Photoshop Licenses: This role requires active subscriptions to both applications.



Why You'll Love Working with Us:

• Clear Systems:We use one on one training and documented SOPs for everything, so you'll never be guessing what to do or how to do it.

• Supportive Team: We’re here to help each other out, and we’ll make sure you have everything you need to succeed.

• Steady Work: Real estate photography keeps a consistent pace, so you'll have reliable work rather than feast-or-famine scheduling.

• Room to Grow: As our business expands, so does the role. We'd love to find someone who wants to grow with us long-term.



If you are interested: Send your resume, a screenshot of an internet speed test, and a video introducing yourself to

1. Are you applying for Video 1, Video 2, or both? 

2. Which tools do you use? Example: Runway, Kling, Veo, Midjourney, After Effects, Blender, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, etc. 

3. For Video 1: Can you create realistic VFX involving waves, water, sand, splash, and 3D text? Please show examples. 

4. For Video 2: Can you film or organize simple scenes with real people if AI/stock footage is not enough? 

5. Please send 3–5 examples of your best relevant work. 

6. What exactly did you personally do in those examples? 

7. Are you comfortable working from a very detailed storyboard and following exact visual instructions? 

8. What would be your recommended workflow for this type of project? 

9. What is your estimated price range for a 30–60 second video of this quality? 

10. How many revisions are included? 

________________________________________

Important Quality Requirement

We are not looking for someone who simply says, “Yes, I can do it.”

We are looking for someone who can say:

• “This part is possible with AI.” 

• “This part needs VFX.” 

• “This part should be filmed.” 

• “This part is risky.” 

• “This is the best workflow.” 

• “Here is a small test before we continue.” 

Honesty and technical judgment are more important than overpromising.

________________________________________

First Step / Test

Before awarding the full project, we may request a short paid test scene.

For Video 1, this could be a 5–10 second sample showing wave / water / 3D wordmark integration.

For Video 2, this could be a 10–15 second sample scene showing the intended style, pacing, stock/AI/filmed material approach, and overall brand feeling.

________________________________________

Brand Context

CruiseLife is a lifestyle and fashion brand. The tone should be:

• Positive 

• Sunny 

• Elegant 

• Emotional 

• Aspirational 

• Premium but not arrogant 

• Suitable for international marketing 

The goal is to create video content that feels like a real brand campaign, not like a cheap AI experiment.

________________________________________

Please Do Not Apply If

• You only create basic AI videos without editing skill 

• You only use stock footage 

• You cannot do or coordinate VFX 

• You cannot follow a detailed storyboard 

• You cannot communicate clearly in English 

• You cannot show relevant examples 

• You are not comfortable doing a small test first 

________________________________________

Final Deliverables

Final deliverables should include:

• Final video file in high quality 

• Version suitable for website / social media 

• Project files if agreed 

• Source assets where legally possible 

• Confirmation that all materials are cleared for commercial use

title: Real Estate Executive Assistant & Property Manager (Full-Time, US CST)
description:
About Us:

We are a Chicago-based real estate investment and property management company. We acquire properties, manage a small portfolio of short-term rentals, and utilize data-driven systems to find new leads. We are looking for a dedicated, long-term, full-time Executive Assistant to become the operational backbone of our company and handle a wide variety of administrative tasks.



IMPORTANT: We are looking for a direct hire. NO AGENCIES. We want someone who is looking for a stable, single-client home.



What You Will Do (The Day-to-Day):

This is a dynamic role. Some days you will be heavily focused on data, and other days you will be doing general administrative research or organizing files. Your responsibilities will include:



General Administration & Ad-Hoc Projects (The Bulk of Your Time): Managing the executive inbox, organizing Google Drive folders, researching new software/tools, creating and updating Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and general data entry.



Financial Accuracy: Handling receipts, invoices, and expense tracking. You must be able to cross-reference actual receipts against spreadsheets with 100?curacy. Accuracy is more important to us than speed.



Short-Term Rental Management (1-2 Hours/Week): Managing guest communications via Hospitable, handling Airbnb claims, and coordinating seamlessly with our local cleaning crews (Turno) and handymen in Chicago.



CRM Management & Lead Gen (1-2 Hours/Day): Maintaining our Podio database, running property data (like geocoding or zoning), and ensuring our workflows stay organized. There is also potential for Inside Sales (ISA) work, such as calling leads or coordinating with answering services.



Requirements (Non-Negotiable):



Hours: You must work full-time during US Central Standard Time (CST) business hours. This means working the graveyard shift in the Philippines.



Time Tracking: All hours must be logged in real time using our time tracking software. This is non-negotiable and is verified daily.



Single-Client Commitment: This is a full-time, exclusive role. We are aware that billing multiple clients simultaneously happens in the VA community. We do not permit it and we verify compliance. If this is your practice, please do not apply.



Infrastructure: You must have a primary high-speed internet connection AND a reliable backup internet source (mobile hotspot/pocket WiFi). You must also have backup power (UPS or generator) to work through brownouts/typhoons.



Tech Comfort: You don't need to be a developer, but you must be comfortable learning new platforms quickly (Podio, Google Workspace, Hospitable, Zapier).



Communication: Flawless written English and a comfortable, professional phone voice for calling US-based vendors.



The "Bias for Action": If a guest reports a stain or a document is missing, you don't just report the problem to the owner—you initiate the solution, order the replacement, and present the completed task.



How to Apply:

We receive dozens of applications, and we only hire people who read the details.



Please apply via
/platfor
ssage.



To prove you have read this entire job post, you must change the subject line of your application to: "Chicago RE Admin - [Insert Your Favorite Color]". If your subject line says anything else, your application will be deleted.



In your message, include a brief summary of your administrative experience and describe a time you had to find an answer yourself without asking your manager. What was the situation and how did you find it?



Please include a link to a 1-minute voice recording (using Vocaroo or similar) introducing yourself and explaining your backup power/internet setup.



Note: Finalists will be required to complete a brief skills assessment via TestGorilla to verify data entry and reasoning skills.



Compensation & Performance Bonuses:

-Strong Base Pay: $1,000 USD per month, paid bi-weekly via Wise or PayPal.

-Monthly Operational Bonuses: Up to $200/month in extra pay tied directly to flawless execution. You earn this by maintaining 100% accuracy in tasks including Asana task execution, and keeping our Airbnb guest ratings at 4.9+ stars.

-Acquisition Bonuses ($500 per closed deal): > This is NOT a bonus for doing standard CRM data entry on existing leads. To earn this bonus, you must be the originator of the warm lead. This means you either:

1) Actively prospected, cold-called, or texted a raw lead, successfully qualified their motivation, and handed them off to our team.

2) Handled a live inbound lead from our answering service, conducted the initial intake, and successfully booked the appointment. If your proactive communication brings a qualified seller to the table and we buy the house, you get $500.



We want to pay top of the market for a superstar who makes our lives easier and helps the business grow. If you want a long-term home where your attention to detail is financially rewarded, we want to hear from you.

title: Short-Form Video Editor – High Volume, Fixed Monthly Pay
description:
You get stable monthly income, a clear repeatable process, and a long-term role on a fast-growing content brand.



We are looking for a reliable, fast video editor to join the content team of a German Instagram and TikTok creator in the business niche. The account has 11,000+ followers and is growing fast. We are scaling content volume now ahead of a major product launch later this year.





What the job looks like



You edit short-form vertical videos (45-90 seconds) for Instagram Reels and TikTok. The format is consistent and repeatable: the creator speaks to camera, you remove the background in CapCut, drop in AI-generated images behind him, and sync them to his talking points.



Every video follows the same template. Once you learn it, editing is fast. A good editor will finish 5-10 clips per hour.



Expected output is around 180 clips per month – roughly 1 new Reel and 5 recycled Test-Reels per day.



This is fully async work. You receive footage and assets in Google Drive, edit, and upload exports back. No daily calls, no time zone pressure.





What you earn



€200/month fixed, paid reliably every month.



At 5-10 clips per hour, this works out to roughly €5-11 per hour of actual editing time. The faster and more consistent you are, the better your effective hourly rate.





What you need



CapCut desktop – you already use it or can learn it fast.

Google Chrome – we use one extension for image generation, easy setup, we walk you through it.

Reliable internet and a computer that handles CapCut without issues.

You can follow a written workflow in English and meet daily deadlines.



You do not need to speak German. The footage is in German but we provide everything you need to navigate it without language skills.





What this role can become



This creator is actively building toward a product launch and long-term growth. If you deliver quality work and grow with us, there is room for more volume, more responsibility, and better pay. You will also be able to use this project as a portfolio reference once we hit major milestones.



We are not looking for someone to try this for a few weeks. We want someone who is in it for the long run.





To apply



Send a short message with 2-3 examples of short-form Reels or TikTok videos you have edited, your typical turnaround time from raw footage to finished export, and confirmation that you have CapCut desktop. That is all we need to get started.

title: Meta Ads Funnel Optimization & Technical Performance Marketing Specialist (Meta Ads, GTM, Pixel/CAPI)
description:
**Important: This role requires mandatory availability and responsiveness during our core business hours of 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM Pacific Standard Time (PST); please only apply if you can commit to this schedule.**



 



PLEASE complete your application form below.



This helps us get to know you better, organize our candidate list, and speeds up the hiring process. 



 



***ONLY applicants who complete this form will be considered!!***




/
/f/3fnzn-13438/50RJUPYIMSF9TIEN4C



 



 



[[[   Who we’re looking for   ]]]



  



We’re looking for a hands-on technical performance marketing specialist to help us fix, optimize, and scale our paid acquisition funnels.



 



The immediate focus is Meta Ads infrastructure: Pixel, Conversions API, GTM, event tracking, custom conversions/events, and attribution accuracy. Longer term, we want someone who can help build and improve funnels across additional channels such as Google Ads, landing pages, analytics, and conversion tracking systems.



 



This is not a general social media role. We need someone who is strong technically and can diagnose how tracking, attribution, and funnel structure affect ad performance.



    



[[[   Who You Are   ]]]



 



- A "Manager of One": You are self-driven, organized, and solve problems efficiently without needing constant supervision.



- Remote-Ready: You have a proven track record of maintaining high visibility in asynchronous environments like ClickUp and Slack.



- Detail-Oriented: You have an exceptional eye for design and aesthetics, ensuring that every pixel aligns with our brand standards.



- Reliable: You understand "Baton Pass" reliability—when you finish a task, you update the status and notify the next person immediately to prevent project stalls.



 



 



[[[   Skills & Qualifications   ]]]



 



We are looking for someone with strong hands-on experience in:



 



Meta Ads Manager campaign setup, optimization, and troubleshooting

Meta Pixel setup, testing, and debugging

Meta Conversions API, including server-side tracking and event deduplication

Google Tag Manager, including tags, triggers, variables, and preview/debug mode

Custom events and custom conversions

Diagnosing inaccurate, duplicate, or misfiring conversion events

Mapping and tracking full paid acquisition funnels

GA4 or similar analytics tools

Landing page and funnel conversion optimization

Clear documentation of tracking architecture and event logic

 



The ideal candidate should be able to trace a conversion event from the ad click all the way through the landing page, form/application, booking system, CRM, and Meta Ads Manager reporting.



 



Must-Have Experience



You should have strong hands-on experience with:



Meta Ads Manager

Meta Pixel

Meta Conversions API

Google Tag Manager

Custom events and custom conversions

Event tracking and debugging

Browser-side vs server-side tracking

Event deduplication

GA4 or similar analytics tools

Paid funnel tracking and conversion optimization

 



Bonus skills:



Zapier: Designing automated workflows and integrations.

SEO: Managing technical on-page visibility.

AEO: Optimizing content for AI search.

 



 



You should be able to confidently answer questions like:



Why is Meta reporting conversions that did not actually happen?

Which button, page load, or server event is firing this conversion?

Is Meta optimizing toward the right action?

Are events duplicated, misfiring, or firing too early in the funnel?

 



Not a Fit If



This role is probably not right if you:



Only know basic campaign setup

Mainly focus on creatives, hooks, or audience testing

Cannot work confidently in Google Tag Manager

Have not debugged Pixel/CAPI issues before

Rely only on Ads Manager numbers without validating tracking accuracy

 



 



 



[[[ What You’ll Work On ]]]



 



You will help us:



Audit our current Meta Ads tracking setup

Diagnose incorrect or misleading conversion events

Fix or rebuild Meta Pixel, CAPI, and GTM tracking

Set up clean custom events and/or custom conversions

Ensure Meta is optimizing toward the correct conversion actions

Improve attribution and reporting accuracy

Track the full funnel from ad click to landing page to lead/application/booking

Identify funnel drop-off points and recommend improvements

Support future funnel buildouts across Meta, Google, and other paid channels

 



[[[ Availability & Logistics ]]]



 



- Time Zone: Commitment to work within or have significant overlap with the Pacific Standard Time (PST) zone.



- Platforms: Our team uses ClickUp, Slack, Sharepoint, Lastpass, Canva, and Hubstaff. Strong proficiency in these platforms is required.



 



[[[ Paid Test Job ]]]



 



We value your time and expertise. Shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete a Paid Test Job. This trial project will allow us to assess your technical skills, your ability to follow our specific SOPs, and your communication style within our asynchronous workflow (ClickUp/Slack).



 



 



We are looking for someone who can start by fixing our Meta tracking and attribution foundation, then potentially continue long-term as our technical funnel and performance marketing specialist.







Thank you for taking your time to complete this form. This helps us get to know you better and speeds up the hiring process. 







We thank all applicants for your interest; however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.







Hope to welcome you to our team!

title: HIRING: AI-POWERED VIDEO & STATIC AD EDITOR | FULL-TIME | Health/Beauty DTC Brand
description:
READ THIS FULLY BEFORE APPLYING.



We are a fast-growing health and beauty e-commerce brand running paid ads aggressively on
 and Instagram across Australia, Canada, the UK, New Zealand, and Ireland. We are looking for ONE dedicated, full-time editor to join our team long-term. This is not a general editing job. If you cannot use AI tools to create content from scratch, please do not apply.



WHO WE ARE



We are a direct-to-consumer health and beauty brand scaling hard across five English-speaking markets. We produce a high volume of direct response video ads and static creatives every week, and we need someone who can execute at a high level while thinking creatively to help us grow.



THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF:



- You have never created direct response ads

- You do not have real, hands-on experience with Higgsfield. This is non-negotiable.

- You cannot use AI tools to generate footage, avatars, images, or scenes

- You only do cinematic, wedding, or YouTube-style editing

- You cannot commit to 40 hours per week

- Your English is not strong. Clear written communication is required daily.

- You cannot source your own content from AI tools, stock, TikTok, UGC, or other sources

- You cannot meet deadlines consistently



WHAT YOU WILL DO



1. Direct response video ads (30 seconds to 5 minutes)



We write the scripts. You turn them into finished ads. You will:



- Use Higgsfield as your primary AI generation tool for footage, scenes, and product visuals

- Supplement with tools like Runway, Sora, Kling, HeyGen, NanoBanana, or Midjourney where needed

- Source additional footage from stock libraries, YouTube, TikTok, Canva, and UGC creators

- Blend all sources into one clean, cohesive, high-converting ad

- Nail the hook in the first 3 seconds. Every single time.

- Use direct response pacing: fast and punchy, not slow or cinematic

- Add captions, music, and SFX where they help. Nothing more.

- Deliver in 9:16, 1:1, and 4:5 formats



2. Static Meta ad creatives



The copy is written by our team. Your job is to bring it to life visually. You will produce:



- Problem-to-solution images

- Benefit-driven visuals

- Testimonial-style creatives

- Us vs. Them comparison images

- Clean, high-converting designs



AI IS A CORE PART OF THIS JOB. YOU MUST ALREADY KNOW HOW TO:



- Work fluently inside Higgsfield. This is your primary tool and experience with it is required.

- Create talking-head or avatar videos using tools like HeyGen

- Generate B-roll, scenes, and product visuals using AI tools

- Write precise prompts to get the output you need

- Combine AI footage with sourced footage into a polished, finished ad

TOOLS YOU SHOULD KNOW:



- Higgsfield (required)

- CapCut, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or After Effects

- Runway, Sora, Kling, HeyGen, or similar AI video tools

- NanoBanana, Midjourney, Pika, or similar AI image tools

- Canva

- Google Drive



All paid tools will be provided by us.



EXPECTED WEEKLY OUTPUT:



- 3 to 6 video ads per week

- 5 to 10 static ads per week

- Hook variations and iterations as needed



Output increases as you get familiar with the brand.



WHAT WE OFFER:



- $800 USD per month to start, with real earning potential as you grow with us

- Full-time, 40 hours per week

- Payment via Wise

- All paid software provided

- Scripts and creative direction provided

- Clear, fast feedback

- A long-term role where strong performance is recognized and rewarded

- A small, focused team where your work directly drives results



WHAT WE DON'T CARE ABOUT:



We are not looking at degrees, certificates, or job titles. We don't care where you studied or what your resume looks like on paper. We care about how you think, how you solve problems, and what you can actually produce. If your work is sharp and your mind is sharper, that matters more to us than anything else.



HOW TO APPLY:



1. Start your application with the word COUNTDOWN. Applications without it will not be opened.

2. List every AI tool you have personally used and exactly what you made with each. Be specific. "Used HeyGen to create avatar ads for a skincare brand" not "familiar with AI." Tell us specifically how you have used Higgsfield.

We are moving fast. We intend to hire within 72 hours of posting this. If you know this is you, do not sit on it. Apply now.



Reply directly to this post or
 us at:

title: Guest Experience Specialist, Third Coast Elevated Stays
description:
Third Coast Elevated Stays is a locally rooted, family-owned property management company serving the Texas coast markets of Galveston, Corpus Christi, Rockport, Port Aransas, and South Padre Island. We are focused on providing elevated stays for our guests and elevated stewardship for our homeowners. Our goal is to grow in a way that celebrates what makes the Texas coast special - its people, coastal culture, beach communities, and local character - while delivering elevated experiences for guests and thoughtful, reliable stewardship for homeowners.



Tech stack (daily tools): Guesty (PMS + guest inbox), Breezeway (tasks/workorders + cleaning), RingCentral (calls/SMS).



Our Elevated Promises

Everything we do is guided by our Elevated Promises. They are our operating standard and the way we earn five-star stays and trusted, long-term homeowner partnerships.



1. Elevated Guest Engagement: Proactive, elevated hospitality from booking to five-star review. 

We believe vacations are special—something people save for, plan for, and look forward to. Our job is to make every stay feel seamless and memorable. We anticipate needs, communicate early, check in during the stay, and resolve issues quickly with warmth and care. Our guest journey is intentionally crafted to deliver the kind of responsiveness, thoughtfulness, and attention to detail that turns great trips into truly elevated experiences.



2. Elevated Home Stewardship: We care for every home as if it were our own.

As homeowners in these markets, we know what true home stewardship looks like. We operate with a proactive mindset of quality, consistency, and pride. Weekly home checks, rigorous cleaning standards, quality control, seasonal readiness, and preventive maintenance are all part of how we ensure every property is clean, protected, and presentation ready, for guests and for you. We treat every home with the same respect and diligence we expect for our own.



3. Elevated Homeowner Partnerships: We treat each home like our own investment.

Every homeowner has different goals – maximizing revenue, balancing personal use, focusing on long-term appreciation, or simply enjoying peace of mind. Our role is to be a true partner in those goals, not simply a property manager. As owners and operators in this region ourselves, our guidance comes from real-world results, not theory. Through regular business reviews, thoughtful design and amenity recommendations, revenue and pricing insights, and brand-building support, we help each property reach its highest potential.



Our Guest Experience team is one of the biggest ways we deliver these promises. This is hospitality work. You are a core part of our team, not an outsourced call-center function.?



Job Description: Guest Experience Specialist - Texas Coast

As a Guest Experience Specialist, you own guest communication and coordination. You are the voice of Third Coast, a core part of our team, and a key driver of five-star stays. You will manage guest messaging and calls, coordinate workorders and cleaning schedules with our local teams and vendors, and bring elevated hospitality and experiences to every stay.



You will own:

• Proactive outreach and warm guest engagement that drives five-star stays

• Guest messaging and phone communication

• Workorder coordination and task follow-through

• Cleaning scheduling and day-to-day coordination with our local team and vendors



Working Hours

We provide live coverage from 7:00am to 11:00pm Central Time (CDT). You will be assigned a consistent shift. On-call after-hour coverage (11:00pm-7:00am CDT) is handled by a separate rotation.



Central Daylight Time (CDT) ? Philippines Time (PHT):

• 7am–3pm CDT ? 8pm–4am PHT

• 11am–7pm CDT ? 12am–8am PHT

• 3pm–11pm CDT ? 4am–12pm PHT

• 11pm–7am CDT ? 12pm–8pm PHT



Compensation and Incentives

• Base pay: $800 USD per month (full-time, based on experience)

• 13th month pay: offered in December (prorated for partial years)

• Monthly 5-Star Bonus: $50 if the monthly average rating is 4.85+ and the review rate is 60%+.

• PTO: Accrues at 1 paid days per month (usable after 90 days; no annual rollover)



Location

These roles are fully remote within the Philippines. 



Role and Responsibilities



Elevated Guest Engagement (Guesty + text/email)

• Answer guest messages (text,
, OTA inbox via Guesty) with warmth, clarity, and genuine care

• Proactively share helpful guidance (arrival, access, weather/roads, home-specific tips) and check in during the stay

• Keep conversations organized and ensure no guest is left waiting or confused

• Ensure every guest experience feels special and elevated



Welcome outreach (required for every reservation)

• Place a welcome phone call to every guest prior to arrival day and send a personalized welcome text

• Confirm access and comfort, offer help, and document any concerns quickly

• Identify opportunities to make the guest’s stay an elevated and memorable experience



Phone support (RingCentral)

• Answer calls quickly and calmly and return missed calls promptly

• Troubleshoot common issues (access, Wi-Fi, amenities, heating/hot tub basics) and escalate when needed



Workorders and coordination (Breezeway)

• Create workorders fast when issues arise and confirm vendor/team acknowledgment

• Track progress, follow up, and close the loop with guests and the local team

• Keep notes and task status clean so handoffs are seamless



Cleaning scheduling and turnovers (Breezeway)

• Coordinate turn cleaning schedules and special requests

• Ensure all turns are scheduled a minimum of one week prior to booking and confirm scheduled cleaner by 6:00pm CDT the night prior to a scheduled cleaning and communicate key notes to cleaners



Documentation and handoffs

• Maintain accurate property notes and updates

• Close out open items before shift end and hand off active issues with clear context



Monthly SLA Standards (required for bonus eligibility)

• Guest messages answered within 15 minutes during your shift (text,
, Guesty inbox)

• Phone calls answered within 30 seconds during your shift

• No open guest messages left at shift end; clean handoffs with clear notes

• Workorders created promptly and vendor/team acknowledgment confirmed quickly



Property Listing Management & OTA Updates

• Maintain accurate, up-to-date listings across Guesty, Airbnb, Vrbo, and other OTAs.

• Update photos, amenities, room configurations, access notes, and seasonal details as needed.

• Ensure descriptions reflect the true guest experience with clear, warm, and helpful language.

• Flag inconsistencies, outdated information, or missing details to the Manager for correction.

• Support seasonal updates (spring break, summer beach season, hurricane season, local events, and holiday periods) to elevate guest expectations and reduce pre-arrival questions.

• Ensure every listing reflects our Elevated Promises — clarity, care, and a welcoming tone.



Local expertise

• Become an expert on Galveston, Corpus Christi, Rockport, Port Aransas, and South Padre Island, including seasonal rhythms, beach conditions, weather impacts, and local norms.

• Learn the best restaurants, cafes, shops, beach activities, family experiences, fishing and boating options, and local attractions in each market so you can offer personalized, concierge-level recommendations that elevate each stay.

• Know our homes in detail: complete Matterport and photo walkthroughs; learn layouts, bedding, amenities, quirks, parking, access instructions, and any “good to know” details for guests.

• Stay current on local events and updates by checking event calendars, tourism sites, and community pages (including relevant local
 groups).

• Use your local and property knowledge proactively to help guests plan better stays, avoid common issues, and feel confidently looked after from booking to checkout.



What we look for

• Excellent written and spoken English and a warm, helpful tone

• Hospitality mindset (you enjoy caring for people, not just closing tickets)

• Strong ownership and follow-through, especially on weekends and busy days

• Detail-oriented and eager to learn homes, markets, and local context

• Comfortable learning and working inside Guesty, Breezeway, and RingCentral

• Reliable internet and a quiet, professional work environment



How to apply



Please submit the following:

• Resume/CV

• 2-minute voice recording introducing yourself and your experience (English)

• Speedtest.net result (screenshot)



Short written samples: How would you respond to the following guest messages?

• “The hot tub isn’t heating. Can you help?”

• “Can we request a late checkout tomorrow?”

• “We’re staying in Port Aransas — any recommendations for a great breakfast spot for our family?”



Short written samples: These three guests message you at the same time. In what order would you respond and why?

• “We can’t get into the home, the code isn’t working.”

• “The Wi-Fi is slow and we need it for work.”

• “Can we check out one hour later?”

title: Experienced Real Estate Caller - Lead Manager
description:
We are hiring a Lead Manager to nurture and manage our pipeline of real estate leads, ensuring no opportunities slip through the cracks. As a Lead Manager, you will be the main point of contact for warm leads: following up with prospects, building rapport, and guiding them until they are ready to close or speak with our acquisitions closer. Additionally, you will engage in targeted outbound prospecting, using our high-quality data (e.g. fresh county records for probate and foreclosures) to initiate conversations with potential sellers. This hybrid role is critical – you'll keep our funnel organized and full by both managing incoming leads and proactively hunting new ones. If you are a people-person who is also organized and driven, this could be a perfect fit.



Who We Are: The OmniKey Group is founded and led by top-ranking Fortune 500 Sales Managers with a proven track record of developing and employing elite talent. We don't just build businesses — we build careers. As we scale aggressively, we are looking for driven individuals who want to grow alongside a leadership team that knows how to invest in people.



Responsibilities:

Lead Nurturing: Manage a pipeline of ~50 active leads in our CRM. Promptly follow up with interested home sellers via phone, text, and
. Your goal is to build relationships over time – check in regularly, understand their situation, and keep our company top-of-mind for when they're ready to sell.



Initial Lead Qualification: Call new inquiries (from inbound calls or web forms) as soon as they come in. Have a friendly introductory conversation to gather information: Why might they sell? When? What's the property condition? Identify serious motivation versus casual interest. Ensure every new lead is contacted and categorized (hot, warm, long-term, etc.).



Set Appointments: When a lead is qualified and shows strong interest/motivation, schedule an appointment or transfer the call to our acquisitions closer. You control the calendar for our acquisition team – scheduling consultations or property visits. Make sure our closer gets all key information before the meeting.



Outbound Prospecting: Devote part of your time to reaching out to cold prospects from our premium data lists (such as probate, pre-foreclosure, or other niche lists we've pulled). Use cold calling or personalized texts/emails to introduce our service and see if they have a property they might consider selling. This "deep prospecting" uses the valuable data provided by our Data Manager to generate new leads beyond the ones who come to us.



Pipeline Organization: Keep the CRM updated meticulously. Log every call, update lead statuses, and add detailed notes after each contact. Set follow-up reminders for each lead so you always remember to call back when promised. No lead should ever be forgotten or left without a next action.



Team Coordination: Work closely with the acquisitions (closing) team. Clearly hand off highly motivated leads with full context (notes about the seller's situation, motivation level, etc.). After our closer makes an offer, circle back with the seller to address any concerns or continue nurturing if they didn't sign immediately. Essentially, you bridge the gap between initial interest and closed deal, keeping communication smooth.



Requirements:

Excellent Communication: Fluent English speaker who can converse naturally and confidently with U.S. homeowners. You have a friendly phone demeanor, active listening skills, and can build trust over multiple conversations. (Experience talking to older American homeowners is a plus – you can strike the right tone of patience and professionalism.)



Sales/Customer Service Experience: 1+ year in a role like sales representative, account manager, customer service, or any position requiring consistent client follow-up. Real estate experience (especially in investing or related to motivated sellers) is highly advantageous – if you've dealt with sellers or real estate leads before, let us know!



Follow-Up and Organizational Skills: A proven ability to juggle dozens of leads and keep an organized system. You never let a task or callback slip. Using a CRM or lead management system should be second nature to you. (If you pride yourself on color-coded spreadsheets or meticulous task lists, that's a good sign!)Google Drive



Persuasion & Empathy: You know how to connect with people, ask the right questions, and handle objections. You're empathetic to sellers' situations (many may be in tough circumstances like foreclosure, probate, etc.) and also persuasive in highlighting how our service can help them.



Tech-Savvy: Comfortable with CRM software, click-to-call phone systems, and general productivity tools (Google Workspace, etc.). Able to learn new apps quickly. Also, must have reliable internet and a headset/quiet workspace for frequent calls.



Work Hours: Available to work full-time on US hours (e.g. 9am–6pm PST). Leads must be called quickly during da
 hours in the US. Flexibility to occasionally adjust hours for an urgent lead is appreciated. We are seeking someone who can commit long-term (12+ months) and become an integral part of the team.



What We Offer:

Base Pay + Commission: Competitive base salary plus commission on each deal you help close. Your earning potential grows with every deal.

Impactful Work: This role is at the heart of our business – you will directly influence our revenue by turning leads into deals. It's rewarding to see your relationship-building result in a family helped and a successful transaction. We often deal with homeowners in difficult situations; you'll take pride in guiding them toward a solution.

Training & Development: We will provide training on our scripts, CRM, and the real estate investment process. You'll learn about the wholesale home-buying industry, negotiations, and how to evaluate seller motivation. Ongoing coaching will be available to sharpen your skills (we succeed when you succeed).



Team Environment: Work with a supportive, growth-minded team. We maintain open communication and regular team check-ins despite being remote. You'll get feedback and recognition for your hard work. We also encourage new ideas – if you have suggestions to improve our follow-up processes, we want to hear them.



Remote Work Lifestyle: This is a 100% remote position. Save on commute time and work from the comfort of your home (or home office). As long as you can reliably cover the required hours and stay connected, you'll enjoy the flexibility of remote work.



How to Apply: If you're excited about nurturing leads and driving deals, we'd love to hear from you. Please send your resume and a short voice recording introducing yourself. In your intro, tell us why you're interested in this Lead Manager role and highlight any relevant experience (especially in real estate or sales). You can use a service like Vocaroo for the recording and share the link. Feel free to also include a brief note or cover letter about a time you successfully convinced a customer or closed a tough deal – we value those who take initiative to showcase their skills. Qualified candidates will be invited to a Zoom interview (and possibly a role-play exercise). Come join a team where your follow-up prowess will be highly valued and rewarded!

title: CRO Expert / Conversion Rate Optimization Specialist
description:
We are a U.S.-based performance growth partner working with home service companies. We scale our clients through paid acquisition, sales optimization, and full-funnel growth systems. We bring e-commerce-level marketing rigor into an industry that has been operating a decade behind.



We're hiring a CRO Expert to own conversion rate optimization across our client portfolio. Your job is to find every drop-off point in the funnel — from ad click to booked appointment — and systematically test, optimize, and lift conversion at every stage.



You'll be working on landing pages, lead forms, quiz funnels, booking flows, and the entire user journey from cold traffic to scheduled in-home consultation. Every percentage point you lift in conversion translates directly to client revenue, which is exactly the kind of impact we measure and reward.



**WHAT YOU'LL DO:**



- Audit landing pages, lead forms, quiz funnels, and booking flows across all client accounts

- Identify drop-off points using heatmaps, session recordings, and analytics (Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity, GA4, etc.)

- Build a structured CRO testing roadmap with clear hypotheses, success metrics, and prioritization

- Design and launch A/B tests on headlines, hooks, offers, form layouts, button placement, social proof, and page structure

- Optimize lead forms — field count, qualification questions, multi-step vs. single-step, mobile vs. desktop

- Improve quiz funnels and lead magnets for higher opt-in and qualification rates

- Optimize Thank You pages, confirmation flows, and post-booking experience

- Work directly with copywriters, designers, and developers to ship test variants quickly

- Track and report on conversion rates at every stage: ad click ? landing page ? lead ? booked appointment ? confirmed appointment

- Maintain a CRO testing log — every test documented with hypothesis, result, and learning

- Recommend funnel architecture improvements based on user behavior data



**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:**



- 3+ years of hands-on CRO experience for lead-gen or e-commerce funnels

- Proven track record lifting conversion rates — you can point to specific tests, before/after numbers, and revenue impact

- Deep knowledge of landing page builders: Unbounce, Instapage, Leadpages, GoHighLevel, Funnelytics, Webflow, or similar

- Fluent in CRO analysis tools: Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity, GA4, Google Tag Manager, Mixpanel

- Strong understanding of A/B testing methodology, statistical significance, and test prioritization frameworks (ICE, PIE, etc.)

- Sharp eye for UX, copy, and design — you understand why pages convert, not just what to test

- Comfortable working with copywriters and designers to ship variants — you give clear, decisive creative feedback

- Strong written and spoken English — you'll be communicating directly with U.S. tea
mbers

- Analytical and methodical — you think in conversion rates, statistical confidence, and incremental lift

- Self-starter who can operate with full autonomy

- Reliable internet, quiet workspace, and ability to overlap with U.S. business hours

- No ego. Humble, hungry, and willing to dig into the messy work of testing and iteration



**BONUS POINTS:**



- Experience with home services, local services, or lead-gen funnels specifically

- Experience optimizing quiz funnels (
, Outgrow, Typeform, 
)

- Familiarity with GoHighLevel funnel building and automation

- Basic HTML, CSS, or no-code dev skills for rapid landing page edits

- Experience working with paid media teams (Meta, Google, TikTok) on creative-to-landing-page alignment

- Background in DTC or e-commerce CRO (we bring e-com principles into home services)

- Experience with multivariate testing, not just basic A/B

- Knowledge of mobile-first design and conversion best practices



**CULTURE:**



This is a relentless execution culture. We move fast, we test fast, we ship fast. We measure conversion lifts in basis points and revenue, not opinions. If you want a chill role where you write strategy docs that never get implemented, this isn't for you. If you want to ship tests every week and watch the numbers move, apply.



**HOW TO APPLY:**



Send your application with:



1. A 60-second video introducing yourself in English — pitch us on why we should hire you

2. Two specific CRO case studies — landing page or funnel, what you tested, before/after conversion rates, revenue impact

3. Screenshots of CRO tools you've used (Hotjar dashboards, A/B test results, GA4 reports — blur sensitive info if needed)

4. Links to landing pages or funnels you've personally built or optimized

5. Why you want this specific role



Applications without a video and case studies will not be considered.



---



**Wage/Salary:**

$1,200 – $2,500 USD/month + performance bonuses tied to conversion lift and client results

The Social Media Manager & Digital Growth Specialist owns our front-facing digital presence: social media channels, paid campaigns, SEO performance, and the website itself. You will work hand-in-hand with the content creator to publish and distribute assets, and you will use AI tools to accelerate every part of that process — from scheduling and copywriting to ad optimization and SEO analysis. This role is equal parts creative and analytical.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



Social Media Management & Publishing

, and X 
).

SEO Optimization

• Conduct ongoing keyword research to identify high-value search opportunities in commercial construction and IMP-related topics.

• Monitor keyword rankings, organic traffic trends, and technical SEO health using Google Search Console, SEMrush, or Ahrefs.

• Coordinate with the content creator to ensure new articles and pages are SEO-optimized before publishing.

PPC & Paid Search

• Build, manage, and optimize Google Ads campaigns targeting commercial construction search terms.

• Set up and refine ad groups, keyword match types, negative keyword lists, and bidding strategies.

• Write ad copy and test variations to improve click-through rates and quality scores.

Website Management & Landing Page Optimization

• Manage and update website content in WordPress or the company CMS — page copy, images, CTAs, and layout.

• Build and improve landing pages for campaigns, lead magnets, and product categories.

• Run A/B tests on page elements (headlines, CTAs, form placement) to improve conversion rates.

• Ensure the website is current, professional, and aligned with active marketing campaigns at all times.

• Identify UX issues that create friction for visitors and work with available resources to resolve them.

AI Marketing Tools

• Use AI tools to accelerate social caption writing, ad copy generation, headline testing, and keyword research.

• Stay current on AI marketing tools and bring new capabilities into the workflow proactively.

• Use AI-powered analytics tools to surface insights from social and website performance data faster.

Analytics & Reporting

• Track and report weekly or monthly on: social follower growth, engagement rates, reach, website traffic, keyword rankings, PPC performance, and leads generated.

• Use Google Analytics, Search Console, and platform analytics to build a clear picture of what is driving results.
